ko.title: $810 Million and a Ticking Clock: Why the White House's Pocket Rescission Has Even Sen. Susan Collins Objecting

segments.src: With days left in the federal fiscal year, the White House has asked to cancel $810 million that Congress already approved.
segments.tr: 연방 회계연도가 며칠 남지 않은 상황에서 백악관은 의회가 이미 승인한 8억 1,000만 달러의 예산 집행 취소를 요청했습니다.

segments.src: The request uses a rarely seen budget tool called a **pocket rescission**, and it has drawn objections from the Republican who chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee.
segments.tr: 이번 요청은 **포켓 리시션(pocket rescission)** 이라 불리는 드문 예산 도구를 사용한 것으로, 상원 세출위원회를 이끄는 공화당 의원의 반발을 사고 있습니다.

segments.src: Below is a plain-language summary of what was announced, why the timing matters, and what happens next.
segments.tr: 아래는 발표된 내용, 시점이 중요한 이유, 그리고 향후 전개될 상황에 대한 알기 쉬운 요약입니다.

segments.src: ## What the White House is asking for
segments.tr: ## 백악관의 요구 내용

segments.src: According to reporting from CNBC, CNN, ABC News and others, the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) sent Congress a package on Friday, Sept.
segments.tr: CNBC, CNN, ABC 뉴스 등의 보도에 따르면, 백악관 예산관리국(OMB)은 9월 27일(금요일) 의회에 관련 안건 패키지를 보냈습니다.

segments.src: It seeks to cancel about $810 million in previously approved spending.
segments.tr: 이는 이전에 승인된 약 8억 1,000만 달러의 지출을 취소하려는 목적을 담고 있습니다.

segments.src: The largest piece is roughly **$567 million** in funding for programs run through the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).
segments.tr: 가장 큰 비중을 차지하는 것은 보건복지부(HHS)가 운영하는 프로그램에 배정된 약 **5억 6,700만 달러**의 자금입니다.

segments.src: Reporting ties it to the Refugee and Entrant Assistance account, which supports the Office of Refugee Resettlement and services for refugees, asylees and other non-citizens.
segments.tr: 보도에 따르면 이 자금은 난민 및 입국자 지원 계정(Refugee and Entrant Assistance account)과 연관되어 있으며, 이는 난민지원국(Office of Refugee Resettlement) 및 난민, 망명 신청자, 기타 비시민권자를 위한 서비스를 지원합니다.

segments.src: The package also reportedly includes about $28 million for HHS research.
segments.tr: 또한 이 패키지에는 HHS 연구를 위한 약 2,800만 달러가 포함되어 있는 것으로 알려졌습니다.

segments.src: It includes smaller items elsewhere in the government, such as $15 million for a Department of Homeland Security case-management pilot for people under immigration supervision who are not detained.
segments.tr: 구금되지 않은 이민 심사 대상자들을 위한 국토안보부(DHS)의 사례 관리 파일럿 프로그램 예산 1,500만 달러 등 정부 내 소규모 항목들도 포함되어 있습니다.

segments.src: The administration says these programs are unnecessary.
segments.tr: 행정부는 이러한 프로그램들이 불필요하다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Its description of the HHS money refers to "pro-illegal immigration programs" and outside organizations that serve non-citizens.
segments.tr: HHS 자금에 대한 그들의 설명에서는 "불법 이민 친화적 프로그램" 및 비시민권자를 지원하는 외부 단체들을 언급하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Officials have also argued that the refugee office is overfunded now that border crossings have fallen.
segments.tr: 또한 당국자들은 국경 통행량이 감소함에 따라 난민 지원 사무소가 과도하게 자금을 지원받고 있다고 주장해 왔습니다.

segments.src: ## What a pocket rescission is, and why the timing matters
segments.tr: ## 포켓 리시션이란 무엇이며, 왜 시점이 중요한가

segments.src: Under the Impoundment Control Act of 1974, a president can ask Congress to cancel, or "rescind," money it has appropriated.
segments.tr: 1974년 제정된 예산동결통제법(Impoundment Control Act)에 따라 대통령은 의회가 승인한 예산의 취소, 즉 "삭감(rescind)"을 의회에 요청할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Once the request is sent, the funds can be withheld for up to 45 days of continuous session.
segments.tr: 요청이 전달되면 해당 자금은 최대 45일의 연속 회의 기간 동안 집행이 보류될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: During that time Congress can pass a bill approving the cancellation.
segments.tr: 그 기간 동안 의회는 취소 승인 법안을 통과시킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: If it doesn't, the money is supposed to be released.
segments.tr: 그렇지 않을 경우 자금은 집행되어야 합니다.

segments.src: A **pocket rescission** is a request sent so late in the fiscal year that the 45-day window runs past Sept.
segments.tr: **포켓 리시션(pocket rescission)** 은 회계연도 말에 너무 늦게 전달되어 45일의 기한이 9월 30일을 넘기게 되는 요청을 말합니다.

segments.src: The money expires before Congress is required to vote on the request.
segments.tr: 의회가 해당 요청에 대해 표결을 해야 하기도 전에 자금이 소멸되는 것입니다.

segments.src: In effect, the funds run out while the request is still pending.
segments.tr: 사실상 요청이 계류 중인 상태에서 자금이 소진되게 됩니다.

segments.src: Critics say the timing is the whole point.
segments.tr: 비평가들은 이 시점 자체가 핵심이라고 말합니다.

segments.src: This year the request arrived five days before the fiscal year ended.
segments.tr: 올해 이 요청은 회계연도 종료 5일을 앞두고 도착했습니다.

segments.src: The House is also out of session until after the November elections, so lawmakers have almost no chance to respond.
segments.tr: 또한 하원은 11월 선거가 끝날 때까지 휴원 상태이기 때문에 입법부 의원들이 대응할 기회가 사실상 없습니다.

segments.src: ## Why Collins and the GAO say it breaks the law
segments.tr: ## 콜린스와 GAO가 법 위반이라고 주장하는 이유

segments.src: The Government Accountability Office (GAO), Congress's nonpartisan watchdog, has concluded that pocket rescissions are not allowed under the Impoundment Control Act.
segments.tr: 의회의 초당적 감시기구인 회계감사원(GAO)은 포켓 리시션이 예산동결통제법에 따라 허용되지 않는다고 결론지었습니다.

segments.src: It reasons that a request timed so Congress cannot act on it lets the president bypass Congress's authority over federal spending.
segments.tr: 의회가 조치를 취할 수 없을 시점에 맞춘 요청은 대통령이 연방 지출에 대한 의회의 권한을 우회하도록 허용하는 셈이라는 논리입니다.

segments.src: Sen.
segments.tr: 상원의원

segments.src: Susan Collins, R-Maine, who chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee, cited that finding in her criticism.
segments.tr: 수전 콜린스(공화·메인주) 상원 세출위원장은 비판에서 이 판정을 인용했습니다.

segments.src: In a statement, she called any attempt to rescind appropriated funds without congressional approval "a clear violation of the law."
segments.tr: 그는 성명을 통해 의회의 승인 없이 승인된 예산을 삭감하려는 모든 시도는 "명백한 법 위반"이라고 규정했습니다.

segments.src: She also said OMB "intentionally withheld these funds for months" to carry out the cancellation.
segments.tr: 또한 OMB가 삭감을 강행하기 위해 "수개월 동안 의도적으로 이 자금의 집행을 보류했다"고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: She noted that Congress approved the money on a bipartisan basis and that it was signed into law.
segments.tr: 그는 의회가 초당적으로 이 예산을 승인했고 법안에 서명되었다는 점을 지적했습니다.

segments.src: Democrats have been sharper.
segments.tr: 민주당 측의 비판은 더욱 날카로웠습니다.

segments.src: Rep.
segments.tr: 하원 예산위원회의 민주당 간사인

segments.src: Brendan Boyle of Pennsylvania, the top Democrat on the House Budget Committee, said the administration knows it cannot get these cuts through Congress and is making them "through the back door."
segments.tr: 브렌던 보일(펜실베이니아주) 하원의원은 행정부가 이러한 예산 삭감안을 의회를 통과시킬 수 없다는 것을 잘 알고 "뒷문"을 통해 이를 추진하고 있다고 말했습니다.

segments.src: Sen.
segments.tr: 오리건주의

segments.src: Jeff Merkley of Oregon called the tactic "an illegal line item veto" and urged Republicans to imagine a Democratic president doing the same.
segments.tr: 제프 머클리 상원의원은 이 전술을 "불법적인 라인 아템 거부권(line item veto)"이라 부르며 공화당원들에게 민주당 대통령이 똑같이 행동한다고 상상해 보라고 촉구했습니다.

segments.src: ## Not the first time
segments.tr: ## 이번이 처음이 아니다

segments.src: The tactic is not new to this administration.
segments.tr: 이러한 전술은 현 행정부에게 새로운 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Last year it sent a pocket rescission of about $4.9 billion in foreign aid near the end of the fiscal year.
segments.tr: 작년에도 행정부는 회계연도 말에 약 49억 달러 규모의 대외 원조에 대한 포켓 리시션을 보낸 바 있습니다.

segments.src: GAO called that move unlawful as well.
segments.tr: GAO는 당시의 조치 역시 불법이라고 규정했습니다.

segments.src: The dispute went to the courts, and the Supreme Court, acting on an emergency request, allowed much of that money to expire without settling the underlying legal question.
segments.tr: 이 분쟁은 법원으로 넘어갔고, 대법원은 긴급 요청에 따라 근본적인 법적 문제를 해결하지 않은 채 해당 자금 대부분이 소멸되도록 허용했습니다.

segments.src: That history explains why both sides are watching this round closely.
segments.tr: 이러한 역사 때문에 양측 모두 이번 라운드를 예의 주시하고 있습니다.

segments.src: The administration has defended pocket rescissions as a legitimate use of its budget authority.
segments.tr: 행정부는 포켓 리시션이 예산 권한의 정당한 행사라고 옹호해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Critics say the earlier outcome encouraged its use again.
segments.tr: 비평가들은 이전의 결과가 행정부로 하여금 이를 다시 사용하도록 부추겼다고 말합니다.

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## 영향을 받는 대상

segments.src: If the cancellation stands, the effect will be felt by the groups that receive federal money for refugee and non-citizen services.
segments.tr: 만약 이번 삭감이 철회되지 않는다면, 그 영향은 난민 및 비시민권자 서비스를 위해 연방 자금을 지원받는 단체들이 체감하게 될 것입니다.

segments.src: That includes resettlement agencies, community organizations and the local programs that depend on them.
segments.tr: 여기에는 재정착 기관, 지역사회 단체 및 이들에 의존하는 지역 프로그램들이 포함됩니다.

segments.src: The cuts also reach some research and immigration-related programs.
segments.tr: 이 예산 삭감은 일부 연구 및 이민 관련 프로그램에도 미칩니다.

segments.src: The exact effect on any one program will depend on how much of its money has already been spent or committed, and that is not clear from public reporting.
segments.tr: 특정 프로그램에 미치는 정확한 영향은 이미 얼마나 많은 자금이 지출되었거나 약정되었는지에 따라 달라질 것이며, 이는 공개된 보도만으로는 명확하지 않습니다.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 앞으로 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: - **Whether the money is released or lapses.** Under the administration's approach, the funds expire on Sept. 30 unless a court or Congress intervenes.
segments.tr: - **자금 집행 여부 또는 소멸 여부.** 행정부의 접근 방식에 따르면 법원이나 의회가 개입하지 않는 한 해당 자금은 9월 30일에 소멸됩니다.

segments.src: - **Legal challenges.** Affected organizations or members of Congress could go to court, as happened after the 2025 rescission.
segments.tr: - **법적 대응.** 2025년 삭감 사태 이후 그랬던 것처럼, 영향을 받는 단체나 의원들이 법원에 제소할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Congressional response.** Collins's objection is notable because it comes from the party that controls Congress and from the chair who oversees the spending bills. It could shape how future appropriations are written.
segments.tr: - **의회의 대응.** 콜린스의 반발은 의회를 장악한 정당 소속이자 지출 예산안을 총괄하는 위원회 위원장으로부터 나왔다는 점에서 주목할 만합니다. 이는 향후 예산안 작성 방식에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Guardrails in future funding bills.** Lawmakers in both parties may push for language that limits or bans late-year rescission requests.
segments.tr: - **향후 예산안의 안전장치.** 양당의 의원들은 연말 예산 삭감 요청을 제한하거나 금지하는 문구를 강하게 요구할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: This dispute is about more than one $810 million package.
segments.tr: 이번 분쟁은 단순히 8억 1,000만 달러 규모의 패키지 그 이상의 의미를 지닙니다.

segments.src: It is about who has the final say over federal spending.
segments.tr: 이는 연방 지출에 대한 최종 결정권을 누가 갖느냐에 관한 문제입니다.

segments.src: The Constitution gives Congress the power of the purse.
segments.tr: 헌법은 의회에 예산 편성권을 부여하고 있습니다.

segments.src: The administration argues it has the flexibility to stop spending it considers wasteful.
segments.tr: 행정부는 낭비라고 판단되는 지출을 중단할 수 있는 유연성이 자신들에게 있다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Critics, including a senior Republican appropriator and GAO, say the pocket rescission is a way around the process that Congress wrote into law.
segments.tr: 공화당의 중진 세출 의원과 GAO를 포함한 비평가들은 포켓 리시션이 의회가 법으로 제정한 절차를 우회하는 수단이라고 말합니다.

zh.title: $810 Million and a Ticking Clock: Why the White House's Pocket Rescission Has Even Sen. Susan Collins Objecting

segments.src: With days left in the federal fiscal year, the White House has asked to cancel $810 million that Congress already approved.
segments.tr: 联邦财年即将结束，白宫已要求取消国会此前批准的 8.1 亿美元拨款。

segments.src: The request uses a rarely seen budget tool called a **pocket rescission**, and it has drawn objections from the Republican who chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee.
segments.tr: 该请求使用了一种罕见的预算工具，被称为**口袋废止（pocket rescission）**，并引发了参议院拨款委员会共和党主席的反对。

segments.src: Below is a plain-language summary of what was announced, why the timing matters, and what happens next.
segments.tr: 以下是关于所宣布的内容、为什么时间节点如此重要以及接下来会发生什么的通俗易懂的总结。

segments.src: ## What the White House is asking for
segments.tr: ## 白宫在要求什么

segments.src: According to reporting from CNBC, CNN, ABC News and others, the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) sent Congress a package on Friday, Sept.
segments.tr: 根据 CNBC、CNN、ABC News 等媒体的报道，管理和预算办公室（OMB）于 9 月 25 日星期五向国会提交了一份方案。

segments.src: It seeks to cancel about $810 million in previously approved spending.
segments.tr: 该方案寻求取消约 8.1 亿美元先前批准的支出。

segments.src: The largest piece is roughly **$567 million** in funding for programs run through the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).
segments.tr: 最大的一部分是通过卫生与公众服务部（HHS）运营的项目资金，约为 **5.67 亿美元**。

segments.src: Reporting ties it to the Refugee and Entrant Assistance account, which supports the Office of Refugee Resettlement and services for refugees, asylees and other non-citizens.
segments.tr: 报道将其与难民和入境者援助账户联系起来，该账户支持难民 resettlement 办公室以及为难民、寻求庇护者和其他非公民提供的服务。

segments.src: The package also reportedly includes about $28 million for HHS research.
segments.tr: 据报道，该方案还包括约 2800 万美元用于 HHS 的研究。

segments.src: It includes smaller items elsewhere in the government, such as $15 million for a Department of Homeland Security case-management pilot for people under immigration supervision who are not detained.
segments.tr: 它包括政府其他地方较小的项目，例如为处于移民监管下但未被拘留的人员提供 1500 万美元的国土安全部个案管理试点项目。

segments.src: The administration says these programs are unnecessary.
segments.tr: 行政部门表示这些项目是不必要的。

segments.src: Its description of the HHS money refers to "pro-illegal immigration programs" and outside organizations that serve non-citizens.
segments.tr: 其对 HHS 资金的描述提到了“亲非法移民项目”以及服务于非公民的外部组织。

segments.src: Officials have also argued that the refugee office is overfunded now that border crossings have fallen.
segments.tr: 官员们还辩称，既然边境越境人数已经下降，难民办公室的资金就过多。

segments.src: ## What a pocket rescission is, and why the timing matters
segments.tr: ## 什么是口袋废止，以及为什么时间节点很重要

segments.src: Under the Impoundment Control Act of 1974, a president can ask Congress to cancel, or "rescind," money it has appropriated.
segments.tr: 根据 1974 年《扣押控制法》，总统可以要求国会取消或“废止”其已经拨付的资金。

segments.src: Once the request is sent, the funds can be withheld for up to 45 days of continuous session.
segments.tr: 请求一旦发出，资金最多可在长达 45 天的连续会议期间被扣留。

segments.src: During that time Congress can pass a bill approving the cancellation.
segments.tr: 在此期间，国会可以通过一项法案批准取消。

segments.src: If it doesn't, the money is supposed to be released.
segments.tr: 如果不通过，这些资金本应被释放。

segments.src: A **pocket rescission** is a request sent so late in the fiscal year that the 45-day window runs past Sept.
segments.tr: **口袋废止**是指在财年接近尾声时发出的请求，以至于 45 天的窗口期超过了 9 月。

segments.src: The money expires before Congress is required to vote on the request.
segments.tr: 在国会被要求对该请求进行投票之前，资金就已经过期了。

segments.src: In effect, the funds run out while the request is still pending.
segments.tr: 实际上，在请求仍在审议期间，资金就已经用尽了。

segments.src: Critics say the timing is the whole point.
segments.tr: 批评人士表示，时间安排正是关键所在。

segments.src: This year the request arrived five days before the fiscal year ended.
segments.tr: 今年，该请求在财年结束前五天到达。

segments.src: The House is also out of session until after the November elections, so lawmakers have almost no chance to respond.
segments.tr: 众议院也将在 11 月选举后才开会，因此议员们几乎没有机会做出回应。

segments.src: ## Why Collins and the GAO say it breaks the law
segments.tr: ## 为什么柯林斯和美国政府问责局（GAO）认为这违反了法律

segments.src: The Government Accountability Office (GAO), Congress's nonpartisan watchdog, has concluded that pocket rescissions are not allowed under the Impoundment Control Act.
segments.tr: 国会的无党派监督机构政府问责局（GAO）得出结论认为，《扣押控制法》不允许口袋废止。

segments.src: It reasons that a request timed so Congress cannot act on it lets the president bypass Congress's authority over federal spending.
segments.tr: 其理由是，时间安排得让国会无法对其采取行动的请求，允许总统绕过国会对联邦支出的权力。

segments.src: Sen.
segments.tr: 参议员。

segments.src: Susan Collins, R-Maine, who chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee, cited that finding in her criticism.
segments.tr: 参议院拨款委员会主席、来自缅因州的共和党人苏珊·柯林斯（Susan Collins）在批评中援引了这一调查结果。

segments.src: In a statement, she called any attempt to rescind appropriated funds without congressional approval "a clear violation of the law."
segments.tr: 她在声明中称，任何未经国会批准就试图废止已拨款资金的行为都是“对法律的明显违反”。

segments.src: She also said OMB "intentionally withheld these funds for months" to carry out the cancellation.
segments.tr: 她还表示，OMB“故意扣留这些资金数月”以执行取消。

segments.src: She noted that Congress approved the money on a bipartisan basis and that it was signed into law.
segments.tr: 她指出，国会是以两党合作的方式批准这笔资金的，并且该资金已被签署成为法律。

segments.src: Democrats have been sharper.
segments.tr: 民主党人的态度则更为尖锐。

segments.src: Rep.
segments.tr: 众议员。

segments.src: Brendan Boyle of Pennsylvania, the top Democrat on the House Budget Committee, said the administration knows it cannot get these cuts through Congress and is making them "through the back door."
segments.tr: 众议院预算委员会首席民主党人、宾夕法尼亚州的布伦丹·博伊尔（Brendan Boyle）表示，行政部门知道它无法通过国会获得这些削减，正在“通过后门”进行。

segments.src: Sen.
segments.tr: 参议员。

segments.src: Jeff Merkley of Oregon called the tactic "an illegal line item veto" and urged Republicans to imagine a Democratic president doing the same.
segments.tr: 俄勒冈州的杰夫·默克利（Jeff Merkley）称这一战术是“非法的单项否决权”，并敦促共和党人想象一下民主党总统也会这么做。

segments.src: ## Not the first time
segments.tr: ## 这并非第一次

segments.src: The tactic is not new to this administration.
segments.tr: 这种战术对本届政府来说并不新鲜。

segments.src: Last year it sent a pocket rescission of about $4.9 billion in foreign aid near the end of the fiscal year.
segments.tr: 去年，它在财年结束附近对大约 49 亿美元的外援发出了口袋废止。

segments.src: GAO called that move unlawful as well.
segments.tr: GAO 也称此举不合法。

segments.src: The dispute went to the courts, and the Supreme Court, acting on an emergency request, allowed much of that money to expire without settling the underlying legal question.
segments.tr: 这场争端闹到了法院，最高法院根据紧急请求，允许大部分资金过期，而没有解决根本的法律问题。

segments.src: That history explains why both sides are watching this round closely.
segments.tr: 这段历史解释了为什么双方都在密切关注这一轮。

segments.src: The administration has defended pocket rescissions as a legitimate use of its budget authority.
segments.tr: 行政部门为口袋废止进行了辩护，称其为其预算权力的合法使用。

segments.src: Critics say the earlier outcome encouraged its use again.
segments.tr: 批评人士称，先前的结果鼓励了其再次使用。

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## 谁受到了影响

segments.src: If the cancellation stands, the effect will be felt by the groups that receive federal money for refugee and non-citizen services.
segments.tr: 如果取消决定维持不变，受联邦资金资助难民和非公民服务的群体将会感受到影响。

segments.src: That includes resettlement agencies, community organizations and the local programs that depend on them.
segments.tr: 这包括 resettlement 机构、社区组织以及依赖它们的本地项目。

segments.src: The cuts also reach some research and immigration-related programs.
segments.tr: 这些削减还波及了一些研究和与移民相关的项目。

segments.src: The exact effect on any one program will depend on how much of its money has already been spent or committed, and that is not clear from public reporting.
segments.tr: 对任何单个项目的具体影响将取决于其资金已经花费或承诺了多少，而公开报道中并未明确这一点。

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 接下来关注什么

segments.src: - **Whether the money is released or lapses.** Under the administration's approach, the funds expire on Sept. 30 unless a court or Congress intervenes.
segments.tr: - **资金是释放还是失效。** 按照行政部门的方法，除非法院或国会进行干预，否则资金将于 9 月 30 日过期。

segments.src: - **Legal challenges.** Affected organizations or members of Congress could go to court, as happened after the 2025 rescission.
segments.tr: - **法律挑战。** 受影响的组织或国会议员可以诉诸法院，就像 2025 年废止案之后发生的那样。

segments.src: - **Congressional response.** Collins's objection is notable because it comes from the party that controls Congress and from the chair who oversees the spending bills. It could shape how future appropriations are written.
segments.tr: - **国会的反应。** 柯林斯的反对值得注意，因为她来自控制国会的政党，并且是监督拨款法案的主席。它可能会塑造未来拨款的编写方式。

segments.src: - **Guardrails in future funding bills.** Lawmakers in both parties may push for language that limits or bans late-year rescission requests.
segments.tr: - **未来拨款法案中的防护栏。** 两党的议员可能会推动限制或禁止年底废止请求的措辞。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: This dispute is about more than one $810 million package.
segments.tr: 这场争端不仅仅关于一个 8.1 亿美元的包裹。

segments.src: It is about who has the final say over federal spending.
segments.tr: 它关乎谁对联邦支出拥有最终决定权。

segments.src: The Constitution gives Congress the power of the purse.
segments.tr: 宪法赋予国会钱袋子权力。

segments.src: The administration argues it has the flexibility to stop spending it considers wasteful.
segments.tr: 行政部门辩称，它拥有停止其认为浪费的支出的灵活性。

segments.src: Critics, including a senior Republican appropriator and GAO, say the pocket rescission is a way around the process that Congress wrote into law.
segments.tr: 包括高级共和党拨款人和 GAO 在内的批评人士表示，口袋废止是绕过国会写入法律的程序的一种方式。

hi.title: $810 मिलियन और टिक-टिक करती घड़ी: व्हाइट हाउस के 'पॉकेट रिसेशन' पर सीनेटर सुसान कोलिन्स को भी आपत्ति क्यों है

segments.src: With days left in the federal fiscal year, the White House has asked to cancel $810 million that Congress already approved.
segments.tr: संघीय वित्तीय वर्ष समाप्त होने में कुछ ही दिन बचे हैं, और व्हाइट हाउस ने $810 मिलियन की उस राशि को रद्द करने का अनुरोध किया है जिसे कांग्रेस पहले ही मंजूरी दे चुकी है।

segments.src: The request uses a rarely seen budget tool called a **pocket rescission**, and it has drawn objections from the Republican who chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee.
segments.tr: यह अनुरोध बजट के एक दुर्लभ उपकरण का उपयोग करता है जिसे **पॉकेट रिसेशन** (pocket rescission) कहा जाता है, और इसने सीनेट विनियोग समिति (Senate Appropriations Committee) की अध्यक्षता करने वाली रिपब्लिकन सदस्य की आपत्तियों को आकर्षित किया है।

segments.src: Below is a plain-language summary of what was announced, why the timing matters, and what happens next.
segments.tr: नीचे इस बात का सरल भाषा में सारांश दिया गया है कि क्या घोषणा की गई थी, समय का महत्व क्यों है, और आगे क्या होगा।

segments.src: ## What the White House is asking for
segments.tr: ## व्हाइट हाउस क्या मांग रहा है

segments.src: According to reporting from CNBC, CNN, ABC News and others, the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) sent Congress a package on Friday, Sept.
segments.tr: CNBC, CNN, ABC News और अन्य की रिपोर्टिंग के अनुसार, प्रबंधन और बजट कार्यालय (OMB) ने शुक्रवार, सितंबर को कांग्रेस को एक पैकेज भेजा।

segments.src: It seeks to cancel about $810 million in previously approved spending.
segments.tr: यह पहले से स्वीकृत लगभग $810 मिलियन के खर्च को रद्द करने का प्रयास करता है।

segments.src: The largest piece is roughly **$567 million** in funding for programs run through the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).
segments.tr: इसका सबसे बड़ा हिस्सा स्वास्थ्य और मानव सेवा विभाग (HHS) के माध्यम से चलाए जाने वाले कार्यक्रमों के लिए लगभग **$567 मिलियन** की फंडिंग है।

segments.src: Reporting ties it to the Refugee and Entrant Assistance account, which supports the Office of Refugee Resettlement and services for refugees, asylees and other non-citizens.
segments.tr: रिपोर्टिंग इसे शरणार्थी और प्रवेशकर्ता सहायता खाते से जोड़ती है, जो शरणार्थी पुनर्वास कार्यालय और शरणार्थियों, शरण चाहने वालों और अन्य गैर-नागरिकों के लिए सेवाओं का समर्थन करता है।

segments.src: The package also reportedly includes about $28 million for HHS research.
segments.tr: पैकेज में कथित तौर पर HHS अनुसंधान के लिए लगभग $28 मिलियन भी शामिल हैं।

segments.src: It includes smaller items elsewhere in the government, such as $15 million for a Department of Homeland Security case-management pilot for people under immigration supervision who are not detained.
segments.tr: इसमें सरकार के अन्य हिस्सों में छोटी वस्तुएं शामिल हैं, जैसे कि आव्रजन निगरानी के तहत उन लोगों के लिए होमलैंड सुरक्षा विभाग के केस-मैनेजमेंट पायलट के लिए $15 मिलियन, जिन्हें हिरासत में नहीं लिया गया है।

segments.src: The administration says these programs are unnecessary.
segments.tr: प्रशासन का कहना है कि ये कार्यक्रम अनावश्यक हैं।

segments.src: Its description of the HHS money refers to "pro-illegal immigration programs" and outside organizations that serve non-citizens.
segments.tr: HHS के पैसे के बारे में इसका विवरण "अवैध आव्रजन-समर्थक कार्यक्रमों" और बाहरी संगठनों को संदर्भित करता है जो गैर-नागरिकों की सेवा करते हैं।

segments.src: Officials have also argued that the refugee office is overfunded now that border crossings have fallen.
segments.tr: अधिकारियों ने यह भी तर्क दिया है कि सीमा पार करने वालों की संख्या कम होने के कारण शरणार्थी कार्यालय को अब अधिक फंडिंग मिल रही है।

segments.src: ## What a pocket rescission is, and why the timing matters
segments.tr: ## पॉकेट रिसेशन क्या है, और समय का महत्व क्यों है

segments.src: Under the Impoundment Control Act of 1974, a president can ask Congress to cancel, or "rescind," money it has appropriated.
segments.tr: 1974 के इपाउंडमेंट कंट्रोल एक्ट (Impoundment Control Act) के तहत, एक राष्ट्रपति कांग्रेस से उस पैसे को रद्द करने या "वापस लेने" (rescind) के लिए कह सकता है जिसे उसने विनियोजित किया है।

segments.src: Once the request is sent, the funds can be withheld for up to 45 days of continuous session.
segments.tr: एक बार अनुरोध भेजे जाने के बाद, धन को 45 दिनों के निरंतर सत्र तक रोका जा सकता है।

segments.src: During that time Congress can pass a bill approving the cancellation.
segments.tr: उस दौरान कांग्रेस रद्दीकरण को मंजूरी देने वाला विधेयक पारित कर सकती है।

segments.src: If it doesn't, the money is supposed to be released.
segments.tr: यदि वह ऐसा नहीं करती है, तो पैसा जारी किया जाना चाहिए।

segments.src: A **pocket rescission** is a request sent so late in the fiscal year that the 45-day window runs past Sept.
segments.tr: एक **पॉकेट रिसेशन** एक ऐसा अनुरोध है जो वित्तीय वर्ष में इतनी देर से भेजा जाता है कि 45-दिनों की अवधि सितंबर के बाद समाप्त हो जाती है।

segments.src: The money expires before Congress is required to vote on the request.
segments.tr: कांग्रेस के अनुरोध पर मतदान करने से पहले ही पैसा समाप्त हो जाता है।

segments.src: In effect, the funds run out while the request is still pending.
segments.tr: वास्तव में, अनुरोध के लंबित रहने के दौरान ही धन समाप्त हो जाता है।

segments.src: Critics say the timing is the whole point.
segments.tr: आलोचकों का कहना है कि समय ही मुख्य मुद्दा है।

segments.src: This year the request arrived five days before the fiscal year ended.
segments.tr: इस वर्ष अनुरोध वित्तीय वर्ष समाप्त होने से पांच दिन पहले आया।

segments.src: The House is also out of session until after the November elections, so lawmakers have almost no chance to respond.
segments.tr: सदन भी नवंबर के चुनावों के बाद तक सत्र में नहीं है, इसलिए सांसदों के पास प्रतिक्रिया देने का लगभग कोई मौका नहीं है।

segments.src: ## Why Collins and the GAO say it breaks the law
segments.tr: ## कोलिन्स और GAO का कहना है कि यह कानून तोड़ता है

segments.src: The Government Accountability Office (GAO), Congress's nonpartisan watchdog, has concluded that pocket rescissions are not allowed under the Impoundment Control Act.
segments.tr: सरकारी जवाबदेही कार्यालय (GAO), जो कांग्रेस का गैर-पक्षपाती प्रहरी है, ने निष्कर्ष निकाला है कि इपाउंडमेंट कंट्रोल एक्ट के तहत पॉकेट रिसेशन की अनुमति नहीं है।

segments.src: It reasons that a request timed so Congress cannot act on it lets the president bypass Congress's authority over federal spending.
segments.tr: इसका तर्क है कि इस तरह से समयबद्ध अनुरोध, जिस पर कांग्रेस कार्रवाई नहीं कर सकती, राष्ट्रपति को संघीय खर्च पर कांग्रेस के अधिकार को दरकिनार करने देता है।

segments.src: Sen.
segments.tr: सीनेटर

segments.src: Susan Collins, R-Maine, who chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee, cited that finding in her criticism.
segments.tr: सुसान कोलिन्स, आर-मेन, जो सीनेट विनियोग समिति की अध्यक्षता करती हैं, ने अपनी आलोचना में उस निष्कर्ष का हवाला दिया।

segments.src: In a statement, she called any attempt to rescind appropriated funds without congressional approval "a clear violation of the law."
segments.tr: एक बयान में, उन्होंने कांग्रेस की मंजूरी के बिना विनियोजित धन को रद्द करने के किसी भी प्रयास को "कानून का स्पष्ट उल्लंघन" कहा।

segments.src: She also said OMB "intentionally withheld these funds for months" to carry out the cancellation.
segments.tr: उन्होंने यह भी कहा कि OMB ने रद्दीकरण को अंजाम देने के लिए "जानबूझकर इन निधियों को महीनों तक रोक कर रखा"।

segments.src: She noted that Congress approved the money on a bipartisan basis and that it was signed into law.
segments.tr: उन्होंने उल्लेख किया कि कांग्रेस ने द्विदलीय आधार पर पैसे को मंजूरी दी थी और इसे कानून के रूप में हस्ताक्षरित किया गया था।

segments.src: Democrats have been sharper.
segments.tr: डेमोक्रेट्स अधिक तीखे रहे हैं।

segments.src: Rep.
segments.tr: प्रतिनिधि

segments.src: Brendan Boyle of Pennsylvania, the top Democrat on the House Budget Committee, said the administration knows it cannot get these cuts through Congress and is making them "through the back door."
segments.tr: पेंसिल्वेनिया के ब्रेंडन बॉयल, जो हाउस बजट कमेटी में शीर्ष डेमोक्रेट हैं, ने कहा कि प्रशासन जानता है कि वह कांग्रेस के माध्यम से इन कटौती को प्राप्त नहीं कर सकता है और उन्हें "पिछले दरवाजे से" कर रहा है।

segments.src: Sen.
segments.tr: सीनेटर

segments.src: Jeff Merkley of Oregon called the tactic "an illegal line item veto" and urged Republicans to imagine a Democratic president doing the same.
segments.tr: ओरेगन के जेफ मर्कले ने इस रणनीति को "एक अवैध लाइन आइटम वीटो" कहा और रिपब्लिकन से कल्पना करने का आग्रह किया कि यदि कोई डेमोक्रेटिक राष्ट्रपति ऐसा करता तो क्या होता।

segments.src: ## Not the first time
segments.tr: ## पहली बार नहीं

segments.src: The tactic is not new to this administration.
segments.tr: यह रणनीति इस प्रशासन के लिए नई नहीं है।

segments.src: Last year it sent a pocket rescission of about $4.9 billion in foreign aid near the end of the fiscal year.
segments.tr: पिछले साल इसने वित्तीय वर्ष के अंत के करीब विदेशी सहायता में लगभग $4.9 बिलियन का पॉकेट रिसेशन भेजा था।

segments.src: GAO called that move unlawful as well.
segments.tr: GAO ने उस कदम को भी गैरकानूनी बताया था।

segments.src: The dispute went to the courts, and the Supreme Court, acting on an emergency request, allowed much of that money to expire without settling the underlying legal question.
segments.tr: विवाद अदालतों में गया, और सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने, एक आपातकालीन अनुरोध पर कार्य करते हुए, अंतर्निहित कानूनी प्रश्न को सुलझाए बिना उस पैसे के अधिकांश हिस्से को समाप्त होने दिया।

segments.src: That history explains why both sides are watching this round closely.
segments.tr: वह इतिहास बताता है कि दोनों पक्ष इस दौर को इतनी बारीकी से क्यों देख रहे हैं।

segments.src: The administration has defended pocket rescissions as a legitimate use of its budget authority.
segments.tr: प्रशासन ने अपने बजट अधिकार के वैध उपयोग के रूप में पॉकेट रिसेशन का बचाव किया है।

segments.src: Critics say the earlier outcome encouraged its use again.
segments.tr: आलोचकों का कहना है कि पिछले परिणाम ने इसके फिर से उपयोग को प्रोत्साहित किया।

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## कौन प्रभावित है

segments.src: If the cancellation stands, the effect will be felt by the groups that receive federal money for refugee and non-citizen services.
segments.tr: यदि रद्दीकरण कायम रहता है, तो इसका प्रभाव उन समूहों द्वारा महसूस किया जाएगा जो शरणार्थी और गैर-नागरिक सेवाओं के लिए संघीय धन प्राप्त करते हैं।

segments.src: That includes resettlement agencies, community organizations and the local programs that depend on them.
segments.tr: इसमें पुनर्वास एजेंसियां, सामुदायिक संगठन और उन पर निर्भर स्थानीय कार्यक्रम शामिल हैं।

segments.src: The cuts also reach some research and immigration-related programs.
segments.tr: कटौती कुछ अनुसंधान और आव्रजन-संबंधित कार्यक्रमों तक भी पहुंचती है।

segments.src: The exact effect on any one program will depend on how much of its money has already been spent or committed, and that is not clear from public reporting.
segments.tr: किसी भी एक कार्यक्रम पर सटीक प्रभाव इस बात पर निर्भर करेगा कि उसका कितना पैसा पहले ही खर्च या प्रतिबद्ध किया जा चुका है, और यह सार्वजनिक रिपोर्टिंग से स्पष्ट नहीं है।

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या देखना है

segments.src: - **Whether the money is released or lapses.** Under the administration's approach, the funds expire on Sept. 30 unless a court or Congress intervenes.
segments.tr: - **क्या पैसा जारी किया जाता है या समाप्त हो जाता है।** प्रशासन के दृष्टिकोण के तहत, जब तक कोई अदालत या कांग्रेस हस्तक्षेप नहीं करती, तब तक धन 30 सितंबर को समाप्त हो जाता है।

segments.src: - **Legal challenges.** Affected organizations or members of Congress could go to court, as happened after the 2025 rescission.
segments.tr: - **कानूनी चुनौतियां।** प्रभावित संगठन या कांग्रेस के सदस्य अदालत जा सकते हैं, जैसा कि 2025 के रिसेशन के बाद हुआ था।

segments.src: - **Congressional response.** Collins's objection is notable because it comes from the party that controls Congress and from the chair who oversees the spending bills. It could shape how future appropriations are written.
segments.tr: - **कांग्रेस की प्रतिक्रिया।** कोलिन्स की आपत्ति उल्लेखनीय है क्योंकि यह उस पार्टी से आती है जो कांग्रेस को नियंत्रित करती है और उस अध्यक्ष से आती है जो खर्च बिलों की देखरेख करती है। यह भविष्य के विनियोगों को लिखने के तरीके को आकार दे सकता है।

segments.src: - **Guardrails in future funding bills.** Lawmakers in both parties may push for language that limits or bans late-year rescission requests.
segments.tr: - **भविष्य के फंडिंग बिलों में सुरक्षा उपाय।** दोनों पार्टियों के सांसद ऐसी भाषा के लिए जोर दे सकते हैं जो साल के अंत में रिसेशन अनुरोधों को सीमित या प्रतिबंधित करती है।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: This dispute is about more than one $810 million package.
segments.tr: यह विवाद $810 मिलियन के एक पैकेज से कहीं अधिक के बारे में है।

segments.src: It is about who has the final say over federal spending.
segments.tr: यह इस बारे में है कि संघीय खर्च पर अंतिम निर्णय किसका है।

segments.src: The Constitution gives Congress the power of the purse.
segments.tr: संविधान कांग्रेस को 'पर्स की शक्ति' (power of the purse) देता है।

segments.src: The administration argues it has the flexibility to stop spending it considers wasteful.
segments.tr: प्रशासन का तर्क है कि उसके पास उस खर्च को रोकने का लचीलापन है जिसे वह बेकार मानता है।

segments.src: Critics, including a senior Republican appropriator and GAO, say the pocket rescission is a way around the process that Congress wrote into law.
segments.tr: आलोचकों, जिसमें एक वरिष्ठ रिपब्लिकन विनियोगकर्ता और GAO शामिल हैं, का कहना है कि पॉकेट रिसेशन उस प्रक्रिया को दरकिनार करने का एक तरीका है जिसे कांग्रेस ने कानून में लिखा है।

es.title: 810 millones de dólares y un reloj en cuenta regresiva: por qué la anulación de bolsillo de la Casa Blanca genera objeciones incluso de la senadora Susan Collins

segments.src: With days left in the federal fiscal year, the White House has asked to cancel $810 million that Congress already approved.
segments.tr: A pocos días de que termine el año fiscal federal, la Casa Blanca ha solicitado cancelar 810 millones de dólares que el Congreso ya había aprobado.

segments.src: The request uses a rarely seen budget tool called a **pocket rescission**, and it has drawn objections from the Republican who chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee.
segments.tr: La solicitud utiliza una herramienta presupuestaria poco común llamada **anulación de bolsillo** (*pocket rescission*), y ha generado objeciones por parte de la republicana que preside el Comité de Apropiaciones del Senado.

segments.src: Below is a plain-language summary of what was announced, why the timing matters, and what happens next.
segments.tr: A continuación, se presenta un resumen en lenguaje sencillo de lo que se anunció, por qué importa el momento y qué sucederá a continuación.

segments.src: ## What the White House is asking for
segments.tr: ## Lo que solicita la Casa Blanca

segments.src: According to reporting from CNBC, CNN, ABC News and others, the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) sent Congress a package on Friday, Sept.
segments.tr: Según los informes de CNBC, CNN, ABC News y otros, la Oficina de Administración y Presupuesto (OMB) envió un paquete al Congreso el viernes 25 de septiembre.

segments.src: It seeks to cancel about $810 million in previously approved spending.
segments.tr: Busca cancelar alrededor de 810 millones de dólares en gastos previamente aprobados.

segments.src: The largest piece is roughly **$567 million** in funding for programs run through the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).
segments.tr: La parte más grande corresponde a aproximadamente **567 millones de dólares** en fondos para programas administrados a través del Departamento de Salud y Servicios Humanos (HHS).

segments.src: Reporting ties it to the Refugee and Entrant Assistance account, which supports the Office of Refugee Resettlement and services for refugees, asylees and other non-citizens.
segments.tr: Los informes lo vinculan con la cuenta de Asistencia para Refugiados y Entrantes, que apoya a la Oficina de Reubicación de Refugiados y servicios para refugiados, asilados y otros no ciudadanos.

segments.src: The package also reportedly includes about $28 million for HHS research.
segments.tr: Según los informes, el paquete también incluye unos 28 millones de dólares para investigación del HHS.

segments.src: It includes smaller items elsewhere in the government, such as $15 million for a Department of Homeland Security case-management pilot for people under immigration supervision who are not detained.
segments.tr: Incluye partidas más pequeñas en otras áreas del gobierno, como 15 millones de dólares para un programa piloto de gestión de casos del Departamento de Seguridad Nacional para personas bajo supervisión migratoria que no están detenidas.

segments.src: The administration says these programs are unnecessary.
segments.tr: La administración afirma que estos programas son innecesarios.

segments.src: Its description of the HHS money refers to "pro-illegal immigration programs" and outside organizations that serve non-citizens.
segments.tr: Su descripción del dinero del HHS se refiere a "programas proinmigración ilegal" y organizaciones externas que atienden a no ciudadanos.

segments.src: Officials have also argued that the refugee office is overfunded now that border crossings have fallen.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios también han argumentado que la oficina de refugiados está sobre financiada ahora que los cruces fronterizos han disminuido.

segments.src: ## What a pocket rescission is, and why the timing matters
segments.tr: ## Qué es una anulación de bolsillo y por qué importa el momento

segments.src: Under the Impoundment Control Act of 1974, a president can ask Congress to cancel, or "rescind," money it has appropriated.
segments.tr: Bajo la Ley de Control de Incautaciones de 1974, un presidente puede pedir al Congreso que cancele, o "rescinda", el dinero que ha apropiado.

segments.src: Once the request is sent, the funds can be withheld for up to 45 days of continuous session.
segments.tr: Una vez enviada la solicitud, los fondos pueden retenerse por hasta 45 días de sesión continua.

segments.src: During that time Congress can pass a bill approving the cancellation.
segments.tr: Durante ese tiempo, el Congreso puede aprobar un proyecto de ley que apruebe la cancelación.

segments.src: If it doesn't, the money is supposed to be released.
segments.tr: Si no lo hace, se supone que el dinero debe ser liberado.

segments.src: A **pocket rescission** is a request sent so late in the fiscal year that the 45-day window runs past Sept.
segments.tr: Una **anulación de bolsillo** es una solicitud enviada tan tarde en el año fiscal que el plazo de 45 días se extiende más allá del 30 de septiembre.

segments.src: The money expires before Congress is required to vote on the request.
segments.tr: El dinero expira antes de que el Congreso esté obligado a votar sobre la solicitud.

segments.src: In effect, the funds run out while the request is still pending.
segments.tr: En la práctica, los fondos se agotan mientras la solicitud aún está pendiente.

segments.src: Critics say the timing is the whole point.
segments.tr: Los críticos dicen que el momento elegido es precisamente el propósito.

segments.src: This year the request arrived five days before the fiscal year ended.
segments.tr: Este año la solicitud llegó cinco días antes de que terminara el año fiscal.

segments.src: The House is also out of session until after the November elections, so lawmakers have almost no chance to respond.
segments.tr: La Cámara de Representantes también está en receso hasta después de las elecciones de noviembre, por lo que los legisladores casi no tienen oportunidad de responder.

segments.src: ## Why Collins and the GAO say it breaks the law
segments.tr: ## Por qué Collins y la GAO dicen que viola la ley

segments.src: The Government Accountability Office (GAO), Congress's nonpartisan watchdog, has concluded that pocket rescissions are not allowed under the Impoundment Control Act.
segments.tr: La Oficina de Rendición de Cuentas del Gobierno (GAO), el organismo de control no partidista del Congreso, ha concluido que las anulaciones de bolsillo no están permitidas bajo la Ley de Control de Incautaciones.

segments.src: It reasons that a request timed so Congress cannot act on it lets the president bypass Congress's authority over federal spending.
segments.tr: Razona que una solicitud programada para que el Congreso no pueda actuar sobre ella permite al presidente eludir la autoridad del Congreso sobre el gasto federal.

segments.src: Sen.
segments.tr: La senadora.

segments.src: Susan Collins, R-Maine, who chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee, cited that finding in her criticism.
segments.tr: Susan Collins, republicana por Maine, quien preside el Comité de Apropiaciones del Senado, citó ese hallazgo en sus críticas.

segments.src: In a statement, she called any attempt to rescind appropriated funds without congressional approval "a clear violation of the law."
segments.tr: En un comunicado, calificó cualquier intento de rescindir fondos aprobados sin la autorización del Congreso como "una clara violación de la ley".

segments.src: She also said OMB "intentionally withheld these funds for months" to carry out the cancellation.
segments.tr: También dijo que la OMB "retuvo intencionalmente estos fondos durante meses" para llevar a cabo la cancelación.

segments.src: She noted that Congress approved the money on a bipartisan basis and that it was signed into law.
segments.tr: Señaló que el Congreso aprobó el dinero de manera bipartidista y que fue convertido en ley.

segments.src: Democrats have been sharper.
segments.tr: Los demócratas han sido más duros.

segments.src: Rep.
segments.tr: El representante.

segments.src: Brendan Boyle of Pennsylvania, the top Democrat on the House Budget Committee, said the administration knows it cannot get these cuts through Congress and is making them "through the back door."
segments.tr: Brendan Boyle, de Pensilvania, el demócrata de alto rango en el Comité de Presupuesto de la Cámara de Representantes, dijo que la administración sabe que no puede conseguir estos recortes a través del Congreso y los está haciendo "por la puerta trasera".

segments.src: Sen.
segments.tr: El senador.

segments.src: Jeff Merkley of Oregon called the tactic "an illegal line item veto" and urged Republicans to imagine a Democratic president doing the same.
segments.tr: Jeff Merkley, de Oregón, calificó la táctica como "un veto de partida individual ilegal" e instó a los republicanos a imaginar a un presidente demócrata haciendo lo mismo.

segments.src: ## Not the first time
segments.tr: ## No es la primera vez

segments.src: The tactic is not new to this administration.
segments.tr: La táctica no es nueva para esta administración.

segments.src: Last year it sent a pocket rescission of about $4.9 billion in foreign aid near the end of the fiscal year.
segments.tr: El año pasado envió una anulación de bolsillo de unos 4.900 millones de dólares en ayuda exterior cerca del final del año fiscal.

segments.src: GAO called that move unlawful as well.
segments.tr: La GAO calificó esa medida como ilegal también.

segments.src: The dispute went to the courts, and the Supreme Court, acting on an emergency request, allowed much of that money to expire without settling the underlying legal question.
segments.tr: La disputa llegó a los tribunales, y la Corte Suprema, actuando ante una solicitud de emergencia, permitió que gran parte de ese dinero expirara sin resolver la cuestión legal subyacente.

segments.src: That history explains why both sides are watching this round closely.
segments.tr: Ese historial explica por qué ambas partes están observando esta ronda de cerca.

segments.src: The administration has defended pocket rescissions as a legitimate use of its budget authority.
segments.tr: La administración ha defendido las anulaciones de bolsillo como un uso legítimo de su autoridad presupuestaria.

segments.src: Critics say the earlier outcome encouraged its use again.
segments.tr: Los críticos dicen que el resultado anterior fomentó su uso nuevamente.

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## Quiénes se ven afectados

segments.src: If the cancellation stands, the effect will be felt by the groups that receive federal money for refugee and non-citizen services.
segments.tr: Si la cancelación se mantiene, el efecto será sentido por los grupos que reciben dinero federal para servicios a refugiados y no ciudadanos.

segments.src: That includes resettlement agencies, community organizations and the local programs that depend on them.
segments.tr: Eso incluye agencias de reubicación, organizaciones comunitarias y los programas locales que dependen de ellas.

segments.src: The cuts also reach some research and immigration-related programs.
segments.tr: Los recortes también alcanzan a algunos programas de investigación y relacionados con la inmigración.

segments.src: The exact effect on any one program will depend on how much of its money has already been spent or committed, and that is not clear from public reporting.
segments.tr: El efecto exacto en cualquier programa en particular dependerá de cuánto de su dinero ya se haya gastado o comprometido, y eso no está claro en los informes públicos.

segments.tr: ## Qué observar a continuación

segments.tr: - **Si el dinero se libera o caduca.** Bajo el enfoque de la administración, los fondos expiran el 30 de septiembre a menos que un tribunal o el Congreso intervengan.

segments.tr: - **Respuesta del Congreso.** La objeción de Collins es notable porque proviene del partido que controla el Congreso y de la presidenta que supervisa los proyectos de ley de gastos. Podría moldear cómo se redacten futuras asignaciones.

segments.src: - **Guardrails in future funding bills.** Lawmakers in both parties may push for language that limits or bans late-year rescission requests.
segments.tr: - **Mecanismos de salvaguarda en futuros proyectos de ley de financiamiento.** Los legisladores de ambos partidos pueden presionar por un lenguaje que limite o prohíba las solicitudes de rescisión de fin de año.

ar.title: 810 مليون دولار وساعة تدق: لماذا أثار "إلغاء الجيب" الذي نفذه البيت الأبيض اعتراض حتى السيناتور سوزان كولينز

segments.src: With days left in the federal fiscal year, the White House has asked to cancel $810 million that Congress already approved.
segments.tr: مع بقاء أيام قليلة على نهاية السنة المالية الفيدرالية، طلب البيت الأبيض إلغاء 810 مليون دولار كان الكونغرس قد وافق عليها بالفعل.

segments.src: The request uses a rarely seen budget tool called a **pocket rescission**, and it has drawn objections from the Republican who chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee.
segments.tr: يستخدم هذا الطلب أداة ميزانية نادراً ما تُرى تسمى **إلغاء الجيب** (pocket rescission)، وقد أثار اعتراضات من الجمهورية التي ترأس لجنة المخصصات في مجلس الشيوخ.

segments.src: Below is a plain-language summary of what was announced, why the timing matters, and what happens next.
segments.tr: فيما يلي ملخص بلغة بسيطة لما تم الإعلان عنه، ولماذا يعد التوقيت مهماً، وما الذي سيحدث بعد ذلك.

segments.src: ## What the White House is asking for
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يطلبه البيت الأبيض

segments.src: According to reporting from CNBC, CNN, ABC News and others, the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) sent Congress a package on Friday, Sept.
segments.tr: وفقاً لتقارير من CNBC وCNN وABC News وغيرها، أرسل مكتب الإدارة والميزانية (OMB) حزمة إلى الكونغرس يوم الجمعة، 25 سبتمبر.

segments.src: It seeks to cancel about $810 million in previously approved spending.
segments.tr: تسعى الحزمة إلى إلغاء حوالي 810 مليون دولار من الإنفاق الذي تمت الموافقة عليه مسبقاً.

segments.src: The largest piece is roughly **$567 million** in funding for programs run through the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).
segments.tr: الجزء الأكبر هو ما يقرب من **567 مليون دولار** في تمويل للبرامج التي تديرها وزارة الصحة والخدمات الإنسانية (HHS).

segments.src: Reporting ties it to the Refugee and Entrant Assistance account, which supports the Office of Refugee Resettlement and services for refugees, asylees and other non-citizens.
segments.tr: تربط التقارير هذا المبلغ بحساب مساعدة اللاجئين والوافدين، الذي يدعم مكتب إعادة توطين اللاجئين والخدمات المقدمة للاجئين وطالبي اللجوء وغيرهم من غير المواطنين.

segments.src: The package also reportedly includes about $28 million for HHS research.
segments.tr: كما تتضمن الحزمة وفقاً للتقارير حوالي 28 مليون دولار لأبحاث وزارة الصحة والخدمات الإنسانية.

segments.src: It includes smaller items elsewhere in the government, such as $15 million for a Department of Homeland Security case-management pilot for people under immigration supervision who are not detained.
segments.tr: وتشمل بنوداً أصغر في أماكن أخرى من الحكومة، مثل 15 مليون دولار لبرنامج تجريبي لإدارة القضايا تابع لوزارة الأمن الداخلي للأشخاص الخاضعين لرقابة الهجرة والذين ليسوا رهن الاحتجاز.

segments.src: The administration says these programs are unnecessary.
segments.tr: تقول الإدارة إن هذه البرامج غير ضرورية.

segments.src: Its description of the HHS money refers to "pro-illegal immigration programs" and outside organizations that serve non-citizens.
segments.tr: ويشير وصفها لأموال وزارة الصحة والخدمات الإنسانية إلى "برامج مؤيدة للهجرة غير الشرعية" ومنظمات خارجية تخدم غير المواطنين.

segments.src: Officials have also argued that the refugee office is overfunded now that border crossings have fallen.
segments.tr: كما جادل المسؤولون بأن مكتب اللاجئين يحصل على تمويل زائد الآن بعد أن انخفضت عمليات عبور الحدود.

segments.src: ## What a pocket rescission is, and why the timing matters
segments.tr: ## ما هو "إلغاء الجيب"، ولماذا يعد التوقيت مهماً

segments.src: Under the Impoundment Control Act of 1974, a president can ask Congress to cancel, or "rescind," money it has appropriated.
segments.tr: بموجب قانون مراقبة حجز الأموال لعام 1974، يمكن للرئيس أن يطلب من الكونغرس إلغاء، أو "فسخ"، الأموال التي خصصها.

segments.src: Once the request is sent, the funds can be withheld for up to 45 days of continuous session.
segments.tr: بمجرد إرسال الطلب، يمكن حجب الأموال لمدة تصل إلى 45 يوماً من الجلسة المستمرة.

segments.src: During that time Congress can pass a bill approving the cancellation.
segments.tr: خلال ذلك الوقت يمكن للكونغرس تمرير مشروع قانون يوافق على الإلغاء.

segments.src: If it doesn't, the money is supposed to be released.
segments.tr: إذا لم يفعل ذلك، فمن المفترض أن يتم الإفراج عن الأموال.

segments.src: A **pocket rescission** is a request sent so late in the fiscal year that the 45-day window runs past Sept.
segments.tr: و**إلغاء الجيب** هو طلب يتم إرساله في وقت متأخر جداً من السنة المالية بحيث تتجاوز فترة الـ 45 يوماً تاريخ 30 سبتمبر.

segments.src: The money expires before Congress is required to vote on the request.
segments.tr: تنتهي صلاحية الأموال قبل أن يُطلب من الكونغرس التصويت على الطلب.

segments.src: In effect, the funds run out while the request is still pending.
segments.tr: في الواقع، تنفد الأموال بينما لا يزال الطلب معلقاً.

segments.src: Critics say the timing is the whole point.
segments.tr: يقول النقاد إن التوقيت هو جوهر المسألة.

segments.src: This year the request arrived five days before the fiscal year ended.
segments.tr: هذا العام وصل الطلب قبل خمسة أيام من نهاية السنة المالية.

segments.src: The House is also out of session until after the November elections, so lawmakers have almost no chance to respond.
segments.tr: كما أن مجلس النواب في عطلة حتى ما بعد انتخابات نوفمبر، لذا ليس لدى المشرعين أي فرصة تقريباً للرد.

segments.src: ## Why Collins and the GAO say it breaks the law
segments.tr: ## لماذا تقول كولينز ومكتب مساءلة الحكومة (GAO) إنه يخالف القانون

segments.src: The Government Accountability Office (GAO), Congress's nonpartisan watchdog, has concluded that pocket rescissions are not allowed under the Impoundment Control Act.
segments.tr: خلص مكتب مساءلة الحكومة (GAO)، وهو هيئة الرقابة غير الحزبية التابعة للكونغرس، إلى أن عمليات "إلغاء الجيب" غير مسموح بها بموجب قانون مراقبة حجز الأموال.

segments.src: It reasons that a request timed so Congress cannot act on it lets the president bypass Congress's authority over federal spending.
segments.tr: ويعلل ذلك بأن الطلب الذي يتم توقيته بحيث لا يستطيع الكونغرس التصرف بشأنه يسمح للرئيس بتجاوز سلطة الكونغرس على الإنفاق الفيدرالي.

segments.src: Sen.
segments.tr: السيناتور

segments.src: Susan Collins, R-Maine, who chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee, cited that finding in her criticism.
segments.tr: سوزان كولينز، جمهورية من ولاية مين، التي ترأس لجنة المخصصات في مجلس الشيوخ، استشهدت بهذا الاستنتاج في انتقادها.

segments.src: In a statement, she called any attempt to rescind appropriated funds without congressional approval "a clear violation of the law."
segments.tr: وفي بيان لها، وصفت أي محاولة لإلغاء الأموال المخصصة دون موافقة الكونغرس بأنها "انتهاك واضح للقانون".

segments.src: She also said OMB "intentionally withheld these funds for months" to carry out the cancellation.
segments.tr: كما قالت إن مكتب الإدارة والميزانية "حجب هذه الأموال عمداً لأشهر" لتنفيذ الإلغاء.

segments.src: She noted that Congress approved the money on a bipartisan basis and that it was signed into law.
segments.tr: وأشارت إلى أن الكونغرس وافق على الأموال على أساس الحزبين وأنه تم التوقيع عليها لتصبح قانوناً.

segments.src: Democrats have been sharper.
segments.tr: كان الديمقراطيون أكثر حدة.

segments.src: Rep.
segments.tr: النائب

segments.src: Brendan Boyle of Pennsylvania, the top Democrat on the House Budget Committee, said the administration knows it cannot get these cuts through Congress and is making them "through the back door."
segments.tr: بريندان بويل من بنسلفانيا، وهو كبير الديمقراطيين في لجنة الميزانية بمجلس النواب، قال إن الإدارة تعلم أنها لا تستطيع تمرير هذه التخفيضات عبر الكونغرس وتقوم بها "من الباب الخلفي".

segments.src: Sen.
segments.tr: السيناتور

segments.src: Jeff Merkley of Oregon called the tactic "an illegal line item veto" and urged Republicans to imagine a Democratic president doing the same.
segments.tr: جيف ميركلي من ولاية أوريغون وصف التكتيك بأنه "فيتو غير قانوني على بنود محددة" وحث الجمهوريين على تخيل رئيس ديمقراطي يفعل الشيء نفسه.

segments.src: ## Not the first time
segments.tr: ## ليست المرة الأولى

segments.src: The tactic is not new to this administration.
segments.tr: هذا التكتيك ليس جديداً على هذه الإدارة.

segments.src: Last year it sent a pocket rescission of about $4.9 billion in foreign aid near the end of the fiscal year.
segments.tr: في العام الماضي، أرسلت طلباً لإلغاء الجيب بحوالي 4.9 مليار دولار من المساعدات الخارجية قرب نهاية السنة المالية.

segments.src: GAO called that move unlawful as well.
segments.tr: وصف مكتب مساءلة الحكومة تلك الخطوة بأنها غير قانونية أيضاً.

segments.src: The dispute went to the courts, and the Supreme Court, acting on an emergency request, allowed much of that money to expire without settling the underlying legal question.
segments.tr: انتقل النزاع إلى المحاكم، وسمحت المحكمة العليا، بناءً على طلب طارئ، بانتهاء صلاحية جزء كبير من تلك الأموال دون حسم المسألة القانونية الأساسية.

segments.src: That history explains why both sides are watching this round closely.
segments.tr: هذا التاريخ يفسر سبب مراقبة كلا الجانبين لهذه الجولة عن كثب.

segments.src: The administration has defended pocket rescissions as a legitimate use of its budget authority.
segments.tr: دافعت الإدارة عن عمليات "إلغاء الجيب" باعتبارها استخداماً مشروعاً لسلطتها في الميزانية.

segments.src: Critics say the earlier outcome encouraged its use again.
segments.tr: يقول النقاد إن النتيجة السابقة شجعت على استخدامها مرة أخرى.

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## من المتضرر

segments.src: If the cancellation stands, the effect will be felt by the groups that receive federal money for refugee and non-citizen services.
segments.tr: إذا تم الإلغاء، فسيشعر بالتأثير المجموعات التي تتلقى أموالاً فيدرالية لخدمات اللاجئين وغير المواطنين.

segments.src: That includes resettlement agencies, community organizations and the local programs that depend on them.
segments.tr: ويشمل ذلك وكالات إعادة التوطين، والمنظمات المجتمعية، والبرامج المحلية التي تعتمد عليها.

segments.src: The cuts also reach some research and immigration-related programs.
segments.tr: تطال التخفيضات أيضاً بعض الأبحاث والبرامج المتعلقة بالهجرة.

segments.src: The exact effect on any one program will depend on how much of its money has already been spent or committed, and that is not clear from public reporting.
segments.tr: سيعتمد التأثير الدقيق على أي برنامج على مقدار الأموال التي تم إنفاقها أو الالتزام بها بالفعل، وهذا ليس واضحاً من التقارير العامة.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يجب مراقبته بعد ذلك

segments.src: - **Whether the money is released or lapses.** Under the administration's approach, the funds expire on Sept. 30 unless a court or Congress intervenes.
segments.tr: - **ما إذا كان سيتم الإفراج عن الأموال أو انتهاء صلاحيتها.** بموجب نهج الإدارة، تنتهي صلاحية الأموال في 30 سبتمبر ما لم تتدخل محكمة أو الكونغرس.

segments.src: - **Legal challenges.** Affected organizations or members of Congress could go to court, as happened after the 2025 rescission.
segments.tr: - **التحديات القانونية.** يمكن للمنظمات المتضررة أو أعضاء الكونغرس اللجوء إلى المحكمة، كما حدث بعد إلغاء عام 2025.

segments.src: - **Congressional response.** Collins's objection is notable because it comes from the party that controls Congress and from the chair who oversees the spending bills. It could shape how future appropriations are written.
segments.tr: - **رد فعل الكونغرس.** اعتراض كولينز ملحوظ لأنه يأتي من الحزب الذي يسيطر على الكونغرس ومن الرئيسة التي تشرف على مشاريع قوانين الإنفاق. قد يشكل هذا كيفية كتابة المخصصات المستقبلية.

segments.tr: هذا النزاع يتعلق بأكثر من مجرد حزمة بقيمة 810 مليون دولار.

fr.title: 810 millions de dollars et un compte à rebours : pourquoi l'annulation discrétionnaire de la Maison-Blanche suscite l'opposition même de la sénatrice Susan Collins

segments.src: With days left in the federal fiscal year, the White House has asked to cancel $810 million that Congress already approved.
segments.tr: À quelques jours de la fin de l'exercice budgétaire fédéral, la Maison-Blanche a demandé d'annuler 810 millions de dollars déjà approuvés par le Congrès.

segments.src: The request uses a rarely seen budget tool called a **pocket rescission**, and it has drawn objections from the Republican who chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee.
segments.tr: Cette demande utilise un outil budgétaire rarement vu appelé **annulation discrétionnaire** (pocket rescission), et elle a suscité des objections de la part du républicain qui préside la commission des crédits du Sénat.

segments.src: Below is a plain-language summary of what was announced, why the timing matters, and what happens next.
segments.tr: Voici un résumé en langage clair de ce qui a été annoncé, pourquoi le calendrier est important et ce qui va se passer ensuite.

segments.src: ## What the White House is asking for
segments.tr: ## Ce que demande la Maison-Blanche

segments.src: According to reporting from CNBC, CNN, ABC News and others, the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) sent Congress a package on Friday, Sept.
segments.tr: Selon les reportages de CNBC, CNN, ABC News et d'autres, le Bureau de la gestion et du budget (OMB) a envoyé au Congrès un dossier le vendredi 25 sept.

segments.src: It seeks to cancel about $810 million in previously approved spending.
segments.tr: Il cherche à annuler environ 810 millions de dollars de dépenses préalablement approuvées.

segments.src: The largest piece is roughly **$567 million** in funding for programs run through the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).
segments.tr: La plus grande partie représente environ **567 millions de dollars** de financement pour des programmes gérés par le ministère de la Santé et des Services sociaux (HHS).

segments.src: Reporting ties it to the Refugee and Entrant Assistance account, which supports the Office of Refugee Resettlement and services for refugees, asylees and other non-citizens.
segments.tr: Les rapports l'associent au compte d'assistance aux réfugiés et aux immigrants, qui soutient le Bureau de réinstallation des réfugiés et les services aux réfugiés, demandeurs d'asile et autres non-citoyens.

segments.src: The package also reportedly includes about $28 million for HHS research.
segments.tr: Le dossier comprend également environ 28 millions de dollars pour la recherche du HHS.

segments.src: It includes smaller items elsewhere in the government, such as $15 million for a Department of Homeland Security case-management pilot for people under immigration supervision who are not detained.
segments.tr: Il comprend des éléments plus petits ailleurs dans le gouvernement, tels que 15 millions de dollars pour un projet pilote de gestion de cas du Département de la Sécurité intérieure pour les personnes sous surveillance de l'immigration qui ne sont pas détenues.

segments.src: The administration says these programs are unnecessary.
segments.tr: L'administration affirme que ces programmes sont inutiles.

segments.src: Its description of the HHS money refers to "pro-illegal immigration programs" and outside organizations that serve non-citizens.
segments.tr: Sa description de l'argent du HHS fait référence à des « programmes pro-immigration illégale » et à des organisations externes qui desservent les non-citoyens.

segments.src: Officials have also argued that the refugee office is overfunded now that border crossings have fallen.
segments.tr: Des responsables ont également soutenu que le bureau des réfugiés est surfinancé maintenant que les traversées frontalières ont diminué.

segments.src: ## What a pocket rescission is, and why the timing matters
segments.tr: ## Qu'est-ce qu'une annulation discrétionnaire et pourquoi le calendrier est important

segments.src: Under the Impoundment Control Act of 1974, a president can ask Congress to cancel, or "rescind," money it has appropriated.
segments.tr: En vertu de la loi sur le contrôle des impôts de 1974 (Impoundment Control Act), un président peut demander au Congrès d'annuler, ou de « révoquer », de l'argent qu'il a approprié.

segments.src: Once the request is sent, the funds can be withheld for up to 45 days of continuous session.
segments.tr: Une fois la demande envoyée, les fonds peuvent être retenus pendant un maximum de 45 jours de session continue.

segments.src: During that time Congress can pass a bill approving the cancellation.
segments.tr: Pendant ce temps, le Congrès peut adopter un projet de loi approuvant l'annulation.

segments.src: If it doesn't, the money is supposed to be released.
segments.tr: S'il ne le fait pas, l'argent est censé être libéré.

segments.src: A **pocket rescission** is a request sent so late in the fiscal year that the 45-day window runs past Sept.
segments.tr: Une **annulation discrétionnaire** (pocket rescission) est une demande envoyée si tard dans l'exercice budgétaire que la période de 45 jours dépasse le 30 sept.

segments.src: The money expires before Congress is required to vote on the request.
segments.tr: L'argent expire avant que le Congrès ne soit tenu de voter sur la demande.

segments.src: In effect, the funds run out while the request is still pending.
segments.tr: En effet, les fonds s'épuisent alors que la demande est toujours en suspens.

segments.src: Critics say the timing is the whole point.
segments.tr: Les critiques disent que le calendrier est tout le problème.

segments.src: This year the request arrived five days before the fiscal year ended.
segments.tr: Cette année, la demande est arrivée cinq jours avant la fin de l'exercice budgétaire.

segments.src: The House is also out of session until after the November elections, so lawmakers have almost no chance to respond.
segments.tr: La Chambre est également en vacances jusqu'après les élections de novembre, de sorte que les législateurs n'ont presque aucune chance de répondre.

segments.src: ## Why Collins and the GAO say it breaks the law
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi Collins et le GAO affirment que cela enfreint la loi

segments.src: The Government Accountability Office (GAO), Congress's nonpartisan watchdog, has concluded that pocket rescissions are not allowed under the Impoundment Control Act.
segments.tr: Le Government Accountability Office (GAO), l'organisme de surveillance non partisan du Congrès, a conclu que les annulations discrétionnaires ne sont pas autorisées par la loi sur le contrôle des impôts.

segments.src: It reasons that a request timed so Congress cannot act on it lets the president bypass Congress's authority over federal spending.
segments.tr: Il estime qu'une demande chronométrée de telle sorte que le Congrès ne puisse pas agir permet au président de contourner l'autorité du Congrès sur les dépenses fédérales.

segments.src: Sen.
segments.tr: La sénatrice

segments.src: Susan Collins, R-Maine, who chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee, cited that finding in her criticism.
segments.tr: Susan Collins, R-Maine, qui préside la commission des crédits du Sénat, a cité cette conclusion dans ses critiques.

segments.src: In a statement, she called any attempt to rescind appropriated funds without congressional approval "a clear violation of the law."
segments.tr: Dans une déclaration, elle a qualifié toute tentative de révoquer des fonds affectés sans l'approbation du Congrès de « violation flagrante de la loi ».

segments.src: She also said OMB "intentionally withheld these funds for months" to carry out the cancellation.
segments.tr: Elle a également déclaré que l'OMB « avait intentionnellement retenu ces fonds pendant des mois » pour mener à bien l'annulation.

segments.src: She noted that Congress approved the money on a bipartisan basis and that it was signed into law.
segments.tr: Elle a souligné que le Congrès avait approuvé l'argent sur une base bipartisane et qu'il avait été promulgué.

segments.src: Democrats have been sharper.
segments.tr: Les démocrates ont été plus incisifs.

segments.src: Rep.
segments.tr: Le représentant

segments.src: Brendan Boyle of Pennsylvania, the top Democrat on the House Budget Committee, said the administration knows it cannot get these cuts through Congress and is making them "through the back door."
segments.tr: Brendan Boyle de Pennsylvanie, le principal démocrate de la commission du budget de la Chambre, a déclaré que l'administration sait qu'elle ne peut pas faire passer ces coupes par le Congrès et les fait « par la porte de derrière ».

segments.src: Sen.
segments.tr: Le sénateur

segments.src: Jeff Merkley of Oregon called the tactic "an illegal line item veto" and urged Republicans to imagine a Democratic president doing the same.
segments.tr: Jeff Merkley de l'Oregon a qualifié cette tactique de « veto par poste budgétaire illégal » et a exhorté les républicains à imaginer un président démocrate faire de même.

segments.src: ## Not the first time
segments.tr: ## Ce n'est pas la première fois

segments.src: The tactic is not new to this administration.
segments.tr: Cette tactique n'est pas nouvelle pour cette administration.

segments.src: Last year it sent a pocket rescission of about $4.9 billion in foreign aid near the end of the fiscal year.
segments.tr: L'année dernière, elle a envoyé une annulation discrétionnaire d'environ 4,9 milliards de dollars d'aide étrangère vers la fin de l'exercice budgétaire.

segments.src: GAO called that move unlawful as well.
segments.tr: Le GAO a également qualifié cette mesure d'illégale.

segments.src: The dispute went to the courts, and the Supreme Court, acting on an emergency request, allowed much of that money to expire without settling the underlying legal question.
segments.tr: Le différend a été porté devant les tribunaux, et la Cour suprême, agissant sur une demande d'urgence, a permis à une grande partie de cet argent d'expirer sans régler la question juridique sous-jacente.

segments.src: That history explains why both sides are watching this round closely.
segments.tr: Cette histoire explique pourquoi les deux camps surveillent de près cette manche.

segments.src: The administration has defended pocket rescissions as a legitimate use of its budget authority.
segments.tr: L'administration a défendu les annulations discrétionnaires comme une utilisation légitime de son autorité budgétaire.

segments.src: Critics say the earlier outcome encouraged its use again.
segments.tr: Les critiques affirment que le résultat précédent a encouragé son utilisation à nouveau.

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## Qui est concerné

segments.src: If the cancellation stands, the effect will be felt by the groups that receive federal money for refugee and non-citizen services.
segments.tr: Si l'annulation est maintenue, l'effet se fera sentir par les groupes qui reçoivent de l'argent fédéral pour les services aux réfugiés et aux non-citoyens.

segments.src: That includes resettlement agencies, community organizations and the local programs that depend on them.
segments.tr: Cela comprend les agences de réinstallation, les organisations communautaires et les programmes locaux qui en dépendent.

segments.src: The cuts also reach some research and immigration-related programs.
segments.tr: Les coupes touchent également certains programmes de recherche et liés à l'immigration.

segments.src: The exact effect on any one program will depend on how much of its money has already been spent or committed, and that is not clear from public reporting.
segments.tr: L'effet exact sur un programme donné dépendra de la quantité de son argent qui a déjà été dépensée ou engagée, et cela n'est pas clair dans les reportages publics.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller ensuite

segments.src: - **Whether the money is released or lapses.** Under the administration's approach, the funds expire on Sept. 30 unless a court or Congress intervenes.
segments.tr: - **Que l'argent soit libéré ou qu'il expire.** Selon l'approche de l'administration, les fonds expirent le 30 sept. à moins qu'un tribunal ou le Congrès n'intervienne.

segments.src: - **Legal challenges.** Affected organizations or members of Congress could go to court, as happened after the 2025 rescission.
segments.tr: - **Recours juridiques.** Les organisations touchées ou les membres du Congrès pourraient aller en justice, comme cela s'est produit après l'annulation de 2025.

segments.src: - **Congressional response.** Collins's objection is notable because it comes from the party that controls Congress and from the chair who oversees the spending bills. It could shape how future appropriations are written.
segments.tr: - **Réponse du Congrès.** L'objection de Collins est remarquable car elle vient du parti qui contrôle le Congrès et de la présidente qui supervise les projets de loi de dépenses. Elle pourrait façonner la manière dont les futures appropriations seront rédigées.

segments.src: - **Guardrails in future funding bills.** Lawmakers in both parties may push for language that limits or bans late-year rescission requests.
segments.tr: - **Filets de sécurité dans les futurs projets de loi de financement.** Les législateurs des deux partis pourraient faire pression pour un langage qui limite ou interdit les demandes d'annulation de fin d'année.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: This dispute is about more than one $810 million package.
segments.tr: Ce différend concerne plus qu'un seul paquet de 810 millions de dollars.

segments.src: It is about who has the final say over federal spending.
segments.tr: Il s'agit de savoir qui a le dernier mot sur les dépenses fédérales.

segments.src: The Constitution gives Congress the power of the purse.
segments.tr: La Constitution donne au Congrès le pouvoir de la bourse.

segments.src: The administration argues it has the flexibility to stop spending it considers wasteful.
segments.tr: L'administration soutient qu'elle a la flexibilité nécessaire pour arrêter de dépenser ce qu'elle considère comme du gaspillage.

segments.src: Critics, including a senior Republican appropriator and GAO, say the pocket rescission is a way around the process that Congress wrote into law.
segments.tr: Les critiques, y compris un haut responsable républicain des crédits et le GAO, affirment que l'annulation discrétionnaire est un moyen de contourner le processus que le Congrès a inscrit dans la loi.

segments.src: ## Not the first time
segments.tr: ## Não é a primeira vez

segments.src: The tactic is not new to this administration.
segments.tr: A tática não é nova para esta administração.

segments.src: Last year it sent a pocket rescission of about $4.9 billion in foreign aid near the end of the fiscal year.
segments.tr: No ano passado, ela enviou uma rescisão de bolso de cerca de US$ 4,9 bilhões em ajuda externa perto do final do ano fiscal.

segments.src: GAO called that move unlawful as well.
segments.tr: O GAO chamou esse movimento de ilegal também.

segments.src: The dispute went to the courts, and the Supreme Court, acting on an emergency request, allowed much of that money to expire without settling the underlying legal question.
segments.tr: A disputa foi para os tribunais, e a Suprema Corte, agindo sobre um pedido de emergência, permitiu que grande parte desse dinheiro expirasse sem resolver a questão legal subjacente.

segments.src: That history explains why both sides are watching this round closely.
segments.tr: Esse histórico explica por que ambos os lados estão observando esta rodada de perto.

segments.src: The administration has defended pocket rescissions as a legitimate use of its budget authority.
segments.tr: A administração defendeu as rescisões de bolso como um uso legítimo de sua autoridade orçamentária.

segments.src: Critics say the earlier outcome encouraged its use again.
segments.tr: Os críticos dizem que o resultado anterior encorajou seu uso novamente.

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## Quem é afetado

segments.src: If the cancellation stands, the effect will be felt by the groups that receive federal money for refugee and non-citizen services.
segments.tr: Se o cancelamento for mantido, o efeito será sentido pelos grupos que recebem dinheiro federal para serviços de refugiados e não cidadãos.

segments.src: That includes resettlement agencies, community organizations and the local programs that depend on them.
segments.tr: Isso inclui agências de reassentamento, organizações comunitárias e os programas locais que dependem delas.

segments.src: The cuts also reach some research and immigration-related programs.
segments.tr: Os cortes também atingem alguns programas de pesquisa e relacionados à imigração.

segments.src: The exact effect on any one program will depend on how much of its money has already been spent or committed, and that is not clear from public reporting.
segments.tr: O efeito exato em qualquer programa dependerá de quanto de seu dinheiro já foi gasto ou comprometido, e isso não está claro nas reportagens públicas.

segments.src: ## What to watch next

segments.tr: - **Salvaguardas em futuros projetos de financiamento.** Legisladores de ambos os partidos podem pressionar por uma linguagem que limite ou proíba solicitações de rescisão de fim de ano.
