in.title: $810 Juta dan Waktu yang Terus Berdetak: Mengapa Resesi Saku Gedung Putih Bahkan Membuat Senator Susan Collins Keberatan

segments.src: With days left in the federal fiscal year, the White House has asked to cancel $810 million that Congress already approved.
segments.tr: Dengan tersisa beberapa hari lagi di tahun fiskal federal, Gedung Putih telah meminta untuk membatalkan $810 juta yang telah disetujui oleh Kongres.

segments.src: The request uses a rarely seen budget tool called a **pocket rescission**, and it has drawn objections from the Republican who chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee.
segments.tr: Permintaan tersebut menggunakan alat anggaran yang jarang terlihat yang disebut **pocket rescission**, dan hal itu telah menimbulkan keberatan dari politisi Republik yang memimpin Komite Alokasi Senat.

segments.src: Below is a plain-language summary of what was announced, why the timing matters, and what happens next.
segments.tr: Di bawah ini adalah ringkasan bahasa sederhana dari apa yang diumumkan, mengapa waktu tersebut penting, dan apa yang terjadi selanjutnya.

segments.src: ## What the White House is asking for
segments.tr: ## Apa yang diminta oleh Gedung Putih

segments.src: According to reporting from CNBC, CNN, ABC News and others, the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) sent Congress a package on Friday, Sept.
segments.tr: Menurut laporan dari CNBC, CNN, ABC News, dan lainnya, Kantor Manajemen dan Anggaran (OMB) mengirimkan paket ke Kongres pada hari Jumat, 25 Sept.

segments.src: It seeks to cancel about $810 million in previously approved spending.
segments.tr: Ini berupaya untuk membatalkan sekitar $810 juta dalam pengeluaran yang telah disetujui sebelumnya.

segments.src: The largest piece is roughly **$567 million** in funding for programs run through the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).
segments.tr: Bagian terbesar adalah sekitar **$567 juta** dalam pendanaan untuk program yang dijalankan melalui Departemen Kesehatan dan Layanan Kemanusiaan (HHS).

segments.src: Reporting ties it to the Refugee and Entrant Assistance account, which supports the Office of Refugee Resettlement and services for refugees, asylees and other non-citizens.
segments.tr: Laporan mengaitkannya dengan akun Bantuan Pengungsi dan Pendatang, yang mendukung Kantor Pemukiman Kembali Pengungsi dan layanan untuk pengungsi, pencari suaka, dan non-warga negara lainnya.

segments.src: The package also reportedly includes about $28 million for HHS research.
segments.tr: Paket tersebut juga dilaporkan mencakup sekitar $28 juta untuk penelitian HHS.

segments.src: It includes smaller items elsewhere in the government, such as $15 million for a Department of Homeland Security case-management pilot for people under immigration supervision who are not detained.
segments.tr: Ini mencakup item-item yang lebih kecil di tempat lain di pemerintahan, seperti $15 juta untuk percontohan manajemen kasus Departemen Keamanan Dalam Negeri bagi orang-orang di bawah pengawasan imigrasi yang tidak ditahan.

segments.src: The administration says these programs are unnecessary.
segments.tr: Pemerintah mengatakan bahwa program-program ini tidak perlu.

segments.src: Its description of the HHS money refers to "pro-illegal immigration programs" and outside organizations that serve non-citizens.
segments.tr: Deskripsinya tentang uang HHS merujuk pada "program pro-imigrasi ilegal" dan organisasi luar yang melayani non-warga negara.

segments.src: Officials have also argued that the refugee office is overfunded now that border crossings have fallen.
segments.tr: Para pejabat juga berargumentasi bahwa kantor pengungsi kelebihan dana sekarang setelah penyeberangan perbatasan turun.

segments.src: ## What a pocket rescission is, and why the timing matters
segments.tr: ## Apa itu pocket rescission, dan mengapa waktunya penting

segments.src: Under the Impoundment Control Act of 1974, a president can ask Congress to cancel, or "rescind," money it has appropriated.
segments.tr: Berdasarkan Undang-Undang Pengendalian Penyitaan tahun 1974, seorang presiden dapat meminta Kongres untuk membatalkan, atau "mencabut", uang yang telah dialokasikannya.

segments.src: Once the request is sent, the funds can be withheld for up to 45 days of continuous session.
segments.tr: Setelah permintaan dikirim, dana tersebut dapat ditahan hingga 45 hari sidang berkelanjutan.

segments.src: During that time Congress can pass a bill approving the cancellation.
segments.tr: Selama waktu itu Kongres dapat mengesahkan RUU yang menyetujui pembatalan tersebut.

segments.src: If it doesn't, the money is supposed to be released.
segments.tr: Jika tidak, uang tersebut seharusnya dilepaskan.

segments.src: A **pocket rescission** is a request sent so late in the fiscal year that the 45-day window runs past Sept.
segments.tr: Sebuah **pocket rescission** adalah permintaan yang dikirim begitu terlambat di tahun fiskal sehingga jendela 45 hari melewati 30 Sept.

segments.src: The money expires before Congress is required to vote on the request.
segments.tr: Uang tersebut kedaluwarsa sebelum Kongres diwajibkan untuk memilih permintaan tersebut.

segments.src: In effect, the funds run out while the request is still pending.
segments.tr: Secara efektif, dana tersebut habis saat permintaan masih tertunda.

segments.src: Critics say the timing is the whole point.
segments.tr: Para kritikus mengatakan bahwa waktu adalah intinya.

segments.src: This year the request arrived five days before the fiscal year ended.
segments.tr: Tahun ini permintaan tiba lima hari sebelum tahun fiskal berakhir.

segments.src: The House is also out of session until after the November elections, so lawmakers have almost no chance to respond.
segments.tr: DPR juga sedang tidak bersidang sampai setelah pemilihan bulan November, sehingga para pembuat undang-undang hampir tidak memiliki kesempatan untuk merespons.

segments.src: ## Why Collins and the GAO say it breaks the law
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Collins dan GAO mengatakan itu melanggar hukum

segments.src: The Government Accountability Office (GAO), Congress's nonpartisan watchdog, has concluded that pocket rescissions are not allowed under the Impoundment Control Act.
segments.tr: Kantor Akuntabilitas Pemerintah (GAO), pengawas nonpartisan Kongres, telah menyimpulkan bahwa pocket rescission tidak diizinkan di bawah Undang-Undang Pengendalian Penyitaan.

segments.src: It reasons that a request timed so Congress cannot act on it lets the president bypass Congress's authority over federal spending.
segments.tr: Ini beralasan bahwa permintaan yang waktunya diatur sedemikian rupa sehingga Kongres tidak dapat bertindak atasnya memungkinkan presiden untuk memotong wewenang Kongres atas pengeluaran federal.

segments.src: Sen.
segments.tr: Sen.

segments.src: Susan Collins, R-Maine, who chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee, cited that finding in her criticism.
segments.tr: Susan Collins, R-Maine, yang memimpin Komite Alokasi Senat, mengutip temuan tersebut dalam kritiknya.

segments.src: In a statement, she called any attempt to rescind appropriated funds without congressional approval "a clear violation of the law."
segments.tr: Dalam sebuah pernyataan, ia menyebut segala upaya untuk mencabut dana yang dialokasikan tanpa persetujuan kongres sebagai "pelanggaran hukum yang jelas."

segments.src: She also said OMB "intentionally withheld these funds for months" to carry out the cancellation.
segments.tr: Ia juga mengatakan OMB "dengan sengaja menahan dana ini selama berbulan-bulan" untuk melakukan pembatalan.

segments.src: She noted that Congress approved the money on a bipartisan basis and that it was signed into law.
segments.tr: Ia mencatat bahwa Kongres menyetujui uang tersebut secara bipartisan dan bahwa itu ditandatangani menjadi undang-undang.

segments.src: Democrats have been sharper.
segments.tr: Demokrat bersikap lebih tajam.

segments.src: Rep.
segments.tr: Rep.

segments.src: Brendan Boyle of Pennsylvania, the top Democrat on the House Budget Committee, said the administration knows it cannot get these cuts through Congress and is making them "through the back door."
segments.tr: Brendan Boyle dari Pennsylvania, Demokrat tertinggi di Komite Anggaran DPR, mengatakan pemerintah tahu itu tidak dapat meloloskan pemotongan ini melalui Kongres dan membuatnya "melalui pintu belakang."

segments.src: Sen.
segments.tr: Sen.

segments.src: Jeff Merkley of Oregon called the tactic "an illegal line item veto" and urged Republicans to imagine a Democratic president doing the same.
segments.tr: Jeff Merkley dari Oregon menyebut taktik itu sebagai "hak veto item baris ilegal" dan mendesak Partai Republik untuk membayangkan seorang presiden Demokrat melakukan hal yang sama.

segments.src: ## Not the first time
segments.tr: ## Bukan yang pertama kalinya

segments.src: The tactic is not new to this administration.
segments.tr: Taktik ini bukanlah hal baru bagi pemerintahan ini.

segments.src: Last year it sent a pocket rescission of about $4.9 billion in foreign aid near the end of the fiscal year.
segments.tr: Tahun lalu, mereka mengirimkan pocket rescission sekitar $4,9 miliar dalam bantuan luar negeri mendekati akhir tahun fiskal.

segments.src: GAO called that move unlawful as well.
segments.tr: GAO menyebut langkah itu melanggar hukum juga.

segments.src: The dispute went to the courts, and the Supreme Court, acting on an emergency request, allowed much of that money to expire without settling the underlying legal question.
segments.tr: Perselisihan tersebut pergi ke pengadilan, dan Mahkamah Agung, bertindak atas permintaan darurat, mengizinkan sebagian besar uang tersebut kedaluwarsa tanpa menyelesaikan pertanyaan hukum yang mendasarinya.

segments.src: That history explains why both sides are watching this round closely.
segments.tr: Sejarah itu menjelaskan mengapa kedua belah pihak mengamati babak ini dengan cermat.

segments.src: The administration has defended pocket rescissions as a legitimate use of its budget authority.
segments.tr: Pemerintah telah membela pocket rescission sebagai penggunaan yang sah dari kewenangan anggarannya.

segments.src: Critics say the earlier outcome encouraged its use again.
segments.tr: Para kritikus mengatakan hasil sebelumnya mendorong penggunaannya lagi.

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## Siapa yang terpengaruh

segments.src: If the cancellation stands, the effect will be felt by the groups that receive federal money for refugee and non-citizen services.
segments.tr: Jika pembatalan tersebut tetap berlaku, dampaknya akan dirasakan oleh kelompok-kelompok yang menerima uang federal untuk layanan pengungsi dan non-warga negara.

segments.src: That includes resettlement agencies, community organizations and the local programs that depend on them.
segments.tr: Itu termasuk lembaga pemukiman kembali, organisasi komunitas, dan program lokal yang bergantung pada mereka.

segments.src: The cuts also reach some research and immigration-related programs.
segments.tr: Pemotongan tersebut juga menjangkau beberapa program penelitian dan yang berkaitan dengan imigrasi.

segments.src: The exact effect on any one program will depend on how much of its money has already been spent or committed, and that is not clear from public reporting.
segments.tr: Dampak persisnya pada program apa pun akan bergantung pada berapa banyak uangnya yang telah dihabiskan atau dikomitmenkan, dan itu tidak jelas dari pelaporan publik.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang harus diperhatikan selanjutnya

segments.src: - **Whether the money is released or lapses.** Under the administration's approach, the funds expire on Sept. 30 unless a court or Congress intervenes.
segments.tr: - **Apakah uang tersebut dilepaskan atau kedaluwarsa.** Di bawah pendekatan pemerintah, dana kedaluwarsa pada 30 Sept. kecuali pengadilan atau Kongres turun tangan.

segments.src: - **Legal challenges.** Affected organizations or members of Congress could go to court, as happened after the 2025 rescission.
segments.tr: - **Tantangan hukum.** Organisasi yang terkena dampak atau anggota Kongres dapat pergi ke pengadilan, seperti yang terjadi setelah rescission 2025.

segments.src: - **Congressional response.** Collins's objection is notable because it comes from the party that controls Congress and from the chair who oversees the spending bills. It could shape how future appropriations are written.
segments.tr: - **Respons kongres.** Keberatan Collins patut dicatat karena berasal dari partai yang mengendalikan Kongres dan dari ketua yang mengawasi RUU pengeluaran. Ini bisa membentuk bagaimana alokasi masa depan ditulis.

segments.src: - **Guardrails in future funding bills.** Lawmakers in both parties may push for language that limits or bans late-year rescission requests.
segments.tr: - **Pengaman dalam RUU pendanaan masa depan.** Anggota parlemen di kedua partai mungkin mendorong bahasa yang membatasi atau melarang permintaan rescission akhir tahun.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: This dispute is about more than one $810 million package.
segments.tr: Perselisihan ini lebih dari sekadar satu paket $810 juta.

segments.src: It is about who has the final say over federal spending.
segments.tr: Ini tentang siapa yang memiliki keputusan akhir atas pengeluaran federal.

segments.src: The Constitution gives Congress the power of the purse.
segments.tr: Konstitusi memberikan kekuasaan dompet kepada Kongres.

segments.src: The administration argues it has the flexibility to stop spending it considers wasteful.
segments.tr: Pemerintah berargumen bahwa mereka memiliki fleksibilitas untuk menghentikan pengeluaran yang dianggapnya boros.

segments.src: Critics, including a senior Republican appropriator and GAO, say the pocket rescission is a way around the process that Congress wrote into law.
segments.tr: Para kritikus, termasuk seorang senator Republik senior dan GAO, mengatakan pocket rescission adalah cara untuk menghindari proses yang ditulis Kongres ke dalam undang-undang.

segments.src: ## What the White House is asking for

segments.src: According to reporting from CNBC, CNN, ABC News and others, the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) sent Congress a package on Friday, Sept.

segments.src: The largest piece is roughly **$567 million** in funding for programs run through the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).

segments.src: The administration says these programs are unnecessary.

segments.src: Its description of the HHS money refers to "pro-illegal immigration programs" and outside organizations that serve non-citizens.

segments.tr: また当局者らは、国境を超える人々が減少した現在、難民事務所には過剰な資金が提供されていると主張している。

segments.src: ## What a pocket rescission is, and why the timing matters
segments.tr: ## ポケット・リシッションとは何か、そしてなぜタイミングが重要なのか

segments.src: Under the Impoundment Control Act of 1974, a president can ask Congress to cancel, or "rescind," money it has appropriated.
segments.tr: 1974年差止管理法に基づき、大統領は議会が割り当てた資金の取り消し、すなわち「破棄」を議会に求めることができる。

segments.src: Once the request is sent, the funds can be withheld for up to 45 days of continuous session.
segments.tr: 要求が送付されると、資金は継続会期の最大45日間保留される可能性がある。

segments.src: During that time Congress can pass a bill approving the cancellation.
segments.tr: その間に議会は取り消しを承認する法案を可決することができる。

segments.src: If it doesn't, the money is supposed to be released.
segments.tr: そうしない場合、資金は解放されることになっている。

segments.src: A **pocket rescission** is a request sent so late in the fiscal year that the 45-day window runs past Sept.
segments.tr: **ポケット・リシッション**とは、会計年度のあまりにも終盤に送付されるため、45日間の期限が9月30日を過ぎてしまうような要求のことである。

segments.src: The money expires before Congress is required to vote on the request.
segments.tr: 議会がその要求について採決を求められる前に、資金は期限切れとなる。

segments.src: In effect, the funds run out while the request is still pending.
segments.tr: 実質的に、要求が保留されている間に資金が枯渇することになる。

segments.src: Critics say the timing is the whole point.
segments.tr: 批判派は、このタイミングこそが核心であると述べている。

segments.src: This year the request arrived five days before the fiscal year ended.
segments.tr: 今年、この要求は会計年度終了の5日前に到着した。

segments.src: The House is also out of session until after the November elections, so lawmakers have almost no chance to respond.
segments.tr: また、下院も11月の選挙後まで休会中であるため、議員が対応する機会はほとんどない。

segments.src: ## Why Collins and the GAO say it breaks the law
segments.tr: ## コリンズ議員とGAOが法律違反とする理由

segments.src: The Government Accountability Office (GAO), Congress's nonpartisan watchdog, has concluded that pocket rescissions are not allowed under the Impoundment Control Act.
segments.tr: 議会の非党派の監視機関である政府説明責任局（GAO）は、ポケット・リシッションは差止管理法の下では認められていないと結論づけている。

segments.src: It reasons that a request timed so Congress cannot act on it lets the president bypass Congress's authority over federal spending.
segments.tr: 議会がそれに対処できないようなタイミングで要求を行うことは、大統領が連邦支出に対する議会の権限を迂回することを可能にすると推論している。

segments.tr: 上院議員の

segments.src: Susan Collins, R-Maine, who chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee, cited that finding in her criticism.
segments.tr: メイン州選出の共和党スーザン・コリンズ上院歳出委員長は、その批判の中でこの結論を引用した。

segments.src: In a statement, she called any attempt to rescind appropriated funds without congressional approval "a clear violation of the law."
segments.tr: 彼女は声明の中で、議会の承認なしに割り当てられた資金を破棄しようとするいかなる試も「明白な法律違反」であると呼んだ。

segments.src: She also said OMB "intentionally withheld these funds for months" to carry out the cancellation.
segments.tr: また彼女は、OMBが取り消しを実行するために「これらの資金を何ヶ月も意図的に保留した」と述べた。

segments.src: She noted that Congress approved the money on a bipartisan basis and that it was signed into law.
segments.tr: さらに、議会が超党派ベースでこの資金を承認し、それが法律として署名されたことに言及した。

segments.src: Brendan Boyle of Pennsylvania, the top Democrat on the House Budget Committee, said the administration knows it cannot get these cuts through Congress and is making them "through the back door."
segments.tr: ブレンダン・ボイル下院議員は、政権側はこれらの削減案を議会を通すことができないと分かっており、「裏口から」実行しようとしていると述べた。

segments.src: Sen.

segments.src: Jeff Merkley of Oregon called the tactic "an illegal line item veto" and urged Republicans to imagine a Democratic president doing the same.
segments.tr: ジェフ・メルクリー上院議員はこの戦術を「違法な項目別拒否権」と呼び、もし民主党の大統領が同じことをしたらどうなるか想像するよう共和党に促した。

segments.src: ## Not the first time
segments.tr: ## 今回が初めてではない

segments.src: The tactic is not new to this administration.
segments.tr: この戦術はこの政権にとって新しいものではない。

segments.src: Last year it sent a pocket rescission of about $4.9 billion in foreign aid near the end of the fiscal year.
segments.tr: 昨年、会計年度の終わりに約49億ドルの海外援助のポケット・リシッションを送付した。

segments.src: GAO called that move unlawful as well.
segments.tr: GAOはその動きも違法であると非難した。

segments.src: The dispute went to the courts, and the Supreme Court, acting on an emergency request, allowed much of that money to expire without settling the underlying legal question.
segments.tr: この紛争は裁判所に持ち込まれ、最高裁は緊急申し立てに基づき、根底にある法的問題点を解決しないまま、その資金の大半の失効を認めた。

segments.src: That history explains why both sides are watching this round closely.
segments.tr: この経緯があるため、双方が今回の動きを注視しているのである。

segments.src: The administration has defended pocket rescissions as a legitimate use of its budget authority.
segments.tr: 政権側はポケット・リシッションを予算権限の正当な行使として擁護してきた。

segments.src: Critics say the earlier outcome encouraged its use again.
segments.tr: 批判派は、前回の結果が再びそれを使用することを奨励したと述べている。

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## 影響を受けるのは誰か

segments.src: If the cancellation stands, the effect will be felt by the groups that receive federal money for refugee and non-citizen services.
segments.tr: 取り消しが実行された場合、その影響は難民および非市民向けサービスのための連邦資金を受け取っているグループによって感じられることなる。

segments.src: That includes resettlement agencies, community organizations and the local programs that depend on them.
segments.tr: これには、再定住機関、地域社会組織、そしてそれらに依存している地元のプログラムが含まれる。

segments.src: The cuts also reach some research and immigration-related programs.
segments.tr: この削減は、一部の研究および移民関連のプログラムにも及ぶ。

segments.src: The exact effect on any one program will depend on how much of its money has already been spent or committed, and that is not clear from public reporting.
segments.tr: どのプログラムに対する正確な影響も、その資金のどれだけがすでに支出または約定されているかによって異なり、それは公開報道からは明らかになっていない。

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 今後の注目点

segments.src: - **Whether the money is released or lapses.** Under the administration's approach, the funds expire on Sept. 30 unless a court or Congress intervenes.
segments.tr: - **資金が解放されるか、失効するか。** 政権のアプローチの下では、裁判所や議会が介入しない限り、資金は9月30日に失効する。

segments.src: - **Legal challenges.** Affected organizations or members of Congress could go to court, as happened after the 2025 rescission.
segments.tr: - **法的闘争。** 影響を受ける組織や議会メンバーは、2025年のリシッションの後に起きたように、裁判所に提訴する可能性がある。

segments.src: - **Congressional response.** Collins's objection is notable because it comes from the party that controls Congress and from the chair who oversees the spending bills. It could shape how future appropriations are written.
segments.tr: - **議会の対応。** コリンズの異議は、それが議会を支配する政党から、そして支出法案を監督する委員長から出ているため注目に値する。今後の予算案の作成方法に影響を与える可能性がある。

segments.src: - **Guardrails in future funding bills.** Lawmakers in both parties may push for language that limits or bans late-year rescission requests.
segments.tr: - **将来の資金調達法案におけるガードレール。** 両党の議員は、年度末のリシッション要求を制限または禁止する文言を強く求める可能性がある。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: This dispute is about more than one $810 million package.
segments.tr: この紛争は、8億1000万ドルのパッケージ1つにとどまらない問題である。

segments.src: It is about who has the final say over federal spending.
segments.tr: それは、連邦支出に対する最終的な決定権が誰にあるのかということに関するものである。

segments.src: The Constitution gives Congress the power of the purse.
segments.tr: 憲法は議会に財政権を与えている。

segments.src: The administration argues it has the flexibility to stop spending it considers wasteful.
segments.tr: 政権側は、無駄とみなす支出を停止する柔軟性を持っていると主張している。

segments.src: Critics, including a senior Republican appropriator and GAO, say the pocket rescission is a way around the process that Congress wrote into law.
segments.tr: 上院の共和党歳出委員会の有力者やGAOを含む批判派は、ポケット・リシッションは議会が法律として定めたプロセスを回避する方法であると述べている。

segments.src: ## Who is affected

segments.tr: Wenn die Streichung Bestand hat, werden die Gruppen die Auswirkungen zu spüren bekommen, die Bundesmittel für Flüchtlings- und Nicht-US-Bürger-Dienste erhalten.

segments.src: That includes resettlement agencies, community organizations and the local programs that depend on them.
segments.tr: Dazu gehören Ressettlement-Agenturen, Gemeinschaftsorganisationen und die lokalen Programme, die von ihnen abhängen.

segments.src: The cuts also reach some research and immigration-related programs.
segments.tr: Die Kürzungen betreffen auch einige Forschungs- und einwanderungsbezogene Programme.

segments.src: The exact effect on any one program will depend on how much of its money has already been spent or committed, and that is not clear from public reporting.
segments.tr: Die genauen Auswirkungen auf ein bestimmtes Programm hängen davon ab, wie viel von seinem Geld bereits ausgegeben oder gebunden wurde, und das geht aus öffentlichen Berichten nicht hervor.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Was als Nächstes zu beobachten ist

segments.src: - **Whether the money is released or lapses.** Under the administration's approach, the funds expire on Sept. 30 unless a court or Congress intervenes.
segments.tr: - **Ob das Geld freigegeben wird oder verfällt.** Nach dem Ansatz der Regierung verfallen die Mittel am 30. Sept., es sei denn, ein Gericht oder der Kongress greift ein.

segments.src: - **Congressional response.** Collins's objection is notable because it comes from the party that controls Congress and from the chair who oversees the spending bills. It could shape how future appropriations are written.
segments.tr: - **Reaktion des Kongresses.** Collins' Einwand ist bemerkenswert, weil er von der Partei kommt, die den Kongress kontrolliert, und von der Vorsitzenden, die die Ausgabengesetze beaufsichtigt. Er könnte prägen, wie zukünftige Haushaltsmittel verfasst werden.

segments.src: - **Guardrails in future funding bills.** Lawmakers in both parties may push for language that limits or bans late-year rescission requests.
segments.tr: - **Leitplanken in zukünftigen Finanzierungsgesetzen.** Gesetzgeber beider Parteien könnten auf Formulierungen drängen, die Anträge auf Streichungen zum Jahresende einschränken oder verbieten.

vi.title: $810 Million and a Ticking Clock: Why the White House's Pocket Rescission Has Even Sen. Susan Collins Objecting

segments.src: With days left in the federal fiscal year, the White House has asked to cancel $810 million that Congress already approved.
segments.tr: Chỉ còn vài ngày nữa là kết thúc năm tài chính liên bang, Tòa Bạch ốc đã yêu cầu hủy bỏ 810 triệu đô la mà Quốc hội đã phê duyệt trước đó.

segments.src: The request uses a rarely seen budget tool called a **pocket rescission**, and it has drawn objections from the Republican who chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee.
segments.tr: Yêu cầu này sử dụng một công cụ ngân sách ít được biết đến gọi là **pocket rescission** (cắt giảm ngân sách kiểu bỏ túi), và nó đã vấp phải sự phản đối từ thượng nghị sĩ đảng Cộng hòa giữ chức chủ tịch Ủy ban Phân bổ Ngân sách Thượng viện.

segments.src: Below is a plain-language summary of what was announced, why the timing matters, and what happens next.
segments.tr: Dưới đây là tóm tắt bằng ngôn ngữ đơn giản về những gì đã được thông báo, lý do tại sao thời điểm lại quan trọng và điều gì sẽ xảy ra tiếp theo.

segments.src: ## What the White House is asking for
segments.tr: ## Những gì Tòa Bạch ốc đang yêu cầu

segments.src: According to reporting from CNBC, CNN, ABC News and others, the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) sent Congress a package on Friday, Sept.
segments.tr: Theo các bản tin từ CNBC, CNN, ABC News và các nguồn khác, Văn phòng Quản lý và Ngân sách (OMB) đã gửi cho Quốc hội một gói đề xuất vào thứ Sáu, ngày Sept.

segments.src: It seeks to cancel about $810 million in previously approved spending.
segments.tr: Nó tìm cách hủy bỏ khoảng 810 triệu đô la chi tiêu đã được phê duyệt trước đó.

segments.src: The largest piece is roughly **$567 million** in funding for programs run through the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).
segments.tr: Khoản lớn nhất là khoảng **$567 million** tiền tài trợ cho các chương trình được điều hành thông qua Bộ Y tế và Dịch vụ Nhân sinh (HHS).

segments.src: Reporting ties it to the Refugee and Entrant Assistance account, which supports the Office of Refugee Resettlement and services for refugees, asylees and other non-citizens.
segments.tr: Các bản tin liên kết khoản tiền này với tài khoản Hỗ trợ Người tị nạn và Nhập cư, nơi hỗ trợ Văn phòng Tái định cư Người tị nạn và các dịch vụ cho người tị nạn, người tị nạn chính trị và những người không phải công dân khác.

segments.src: The package also reportedly includes about $28 million for HHS research.
segments.tr: Gói này cũng được cho là bao gồm khoảng 28 triệu đô la cho nghiên cứu của HHS.

segments.src: It includes smaller items elsewhere in the government, such as $15 million for a Department of Homeland Security case-management pilot for people under immigration supervision who are not detained.
segments.tr: Nó bao gồm các mục nhỏ hơn ở những nơi khác trong chính phủ, chẳng hạn như 15 triệu đô la cho một chương trình thí điểm quản lý trường hợp của Bộ An ninh Nội địa dành cho những người nằm dưới sự giám sát di trú nhưng không bị giam giữ.

segments.src: The administration says these programs are unnecessary.
segments.tr: Chính quyền cho biết các chương trình này là không cần thiết.

segments.src: Its description of the HHS money refers to "pro-illegal immigration programs" and outside organizations that serve non-citizens.
segments.tr: Mô tả của họ về số tiền của HHS đề cập đến "các chương trình ủng hộ nhập cư bất hợp pháp" và các tổ chức bên ngoài phục vụ những người không phải công dân.

segments.src: Officials have also argued that the refugee office is overfunded now that border crossings have fallen.
segments.tr: Các quan chức cũng lập luận rằng văn phòng người tị nạn đang bị thừa vốn nay khi số lượng người vượt biên đã giảm.

segments.src: ## What a pocket rescission is, and why the timing matters
segments.tr: ## Pocket rescission là gì, và tại sao thời điểm lại quan trọng

segments.src: Under the Impoundment Control Act of 1974, a president can ask Congress to cancel, or "rescind," money it has appropriated.
segments.tr: Theo Đạo luật Kiểm soát Ngâm quỹ năm 1974, tổng thống có thể yêu cầu Quốc hội hủy bỏ, hay "thu hồi", số tiền mà cơ quan này đã phân bổ.

segments.src: Once the request is sent, the funds can be withheld for up to 45 days of continuous session.
segments.tr: Một khi yêu cầu được gửi đi, các quỹ có thể bị giữ lại trong tối đa 45 ngày họp liên tục.

segments.src: During that time Congress can pass a bill approving the cancellation.
segments.tr: Trong thời gian đó, Quốc hội có thể thông qua một dự luật phê duyệt việc hủy bỏ.

segments.src: If it doesn't, the money is supposed to be released.
segments.tr: Nếu không, số tiền đó dự kiến sẽ được giải phóng.

segments.src: A **pocket rescission** is a request sent so late in the fiscal year that the 45-day window runs past Sept.
segments.tr: Một **pocket rescission** là yêu cầu được gửi quá muộn trong năm tài chính khiến khoảng thời gian 45 ngày kéo dài qua ngày Sept.

segments.src: The money expires before Congress is required to vote on the request.
segments.tr: Số tiền sẽ hết hạn trước khi Quốc hội bắt buộc phải bỏ phiếu về yêu cầu đó.

segments.src: In effect, the funds run out while the request is still pending.
segments.tr: Trên thực tế, các quỹ cạn kiệt trong khi yêu cầu vẫn đang chờ xử lý.

segments.src: Critics say the timing is the whole point.
segments.tr: Các nhà phê bình cho rằng thời điểm chính là mấu chốt của vấn đề.

segments.src: This year the request arrived five days before the fiscal year ended.
segments.tr: Năm nay yêu cầu đã đến năm ngày trước khi năm tài chính kết thúc.

segments.src: The House is also out of session until after the November elections, so lawmakers have almost no chance to respond.
segments.tr: Hạ viện cũng đang nghỉ họp cho đến sau cuộc bầu cử tháng 11, vì vậy các nhà lập pháp hầu như không có cơ hội phản ứng.

segments.src: ## Why Collins and the GAO say it breaks the law
segments.tr: ## Tại sao Collins và GAO cho rằng hành động này vi phạm pháp luật

segments.src: The Government Accountability Office (GAO), Congress's nonpartisan watchdog, has concluded that pocket rescissions are not allowed under the Impoundment Control Act.
segments.tr: Văn phòng Trách nhiệm Giải trình Chính phủ (GAO), cơ quan giám sát phi đảng phái của Quốc hội, đã kết luận rằng việc cắt giảm ngân sách kiểu bỏ túi không được phép theo Đạo luật Kiểm soát Ngâm quỹ.

segments.src: It reasons that a request timed so Congress cannot act on it lets the president bypass Congress's authority over federal spending.
segments.tr: Họ suy luận rằng một yêu cầu được căn giờ sao cho Quốc hội không thể hành động sẽ cho phép tổng thống vượt qua thẩm quyền của Quốc hội đối với chi tiêu liên bang.

segments.src: Sen.
segments.tr: Thượng nghị sĩ

segments.src: Susan Collins, R-Maine, who chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee, cited that finding in her criticism.
segments.tr: Susan Collins, đảng viên Cộng hòa bang Maine, người đứng đầu Ủy ban Phân bổ Ngân sách Thượng viện, đã dẫn 1 kết luận đó trong lời chỉ trích của mình.

segments.src: In a statement, she called any attempt to rescind appropriated funds without congressional approval "a clear violation of the law."
segments.tr: Trong một tuyên bố, bà gọi bất kỳ nỗ lực nào nhằm thu hồi các quỹ đã được phân bổ mà không có sự chấp thuận của Quốc hội là "sự vi phạm rõ ràng pháp luật."

segments.src: She also said OMB "intentionally withheld these funds for months" to carry out the cancellation.
segments.tr: Bà cũng cho biết OMB "đã cố ý giữ lại các quỹ này trong nhiều tháng" để thực hiện việc hủy bỏ.

segments.src: She noted that Congress approved the money on a bipartisan basis and that it was signed into law.
segments.tr: Bà lưu ý rằng Quốc hội đã phê duyệt số tiền này trên cơ sở lưỡng đảng và nó đã được ký thành luật.

segments.src: Democrats have been sharper.
segments.tr: Đảng Dân chủ còn gay gắt hơn.

segments.src: Rep.
segments.tr: Dân biểu

segments.src: Brendan Boyle of Pennsylvania, the top Democrat on the House Budget Committee, said the administration knows it cannot get these cuts through Congress and is making them "through the back door."
segments.tr: Brendan Boyle đến từ Pennsylvania, thành viên Dân chủ hàng đầu trong Ủy ban Ngân sách Hạ viện, cho biết chính quyền biết rằng họ không thể thông qua các khoản cắt giảm này qua Quốc hội và đang thực hiện chúng "qua cửa sau."

segments.src: Sen.
segments.tr: Thượng nghị sĩ

segments.src: Jeff Merkley of Oregon called the tactic "an illegal line item veto" and urged Republicans to imagine a Democratic president doing the same.
segments.tr: Jeff Merkley bang Oregon gọi chiến thuật này là "quyền phủ quyết từng khoản mục bất hợp pháp" và thúc giục đảng Cộng hòa tưởng tượng cảnh một tổng thống đảng Dân chủ làm điều tương tự.

segments.src: ## Not the first time
segments.tr: ## Không phải là lần đầu tiên

segments.src: The tactic is not new to this administration.
segments.tr: Chiến thuật này không có gì mới đối với chính quyền hiện tại.

segments.src: Last year it sent a pocket rescission of about $4.9 billion in foreign aid near the end of the fiscal year.
segments.tr: Năm ngoái, họ đã gửi một yêu cầu cắt giảm ngân sách kiểu bỏ túi khoảng 4,9 tỷ đô la viện trợ nước ngoài gần cuối năm tài chính.

segments.src: GAO called that move unlawful as well.
segments.tr: GAO cũng gọi động thái đó là bất hợp pháp.

segments.src: The dispute went to the courts, and the Supreme Court, acting on an emergency request, allowed much of that money to expire without settling the underlying legal question.
segments.tr: Tranh chấp đã được đưa ra tòa án, và Tối cao Pháp viện, hành động theo một yêu cầu khẩn cấp, đã cho phép phần lớn số tiền đó hết hạn mà không giải quyết vấn đề pháp lý cơ bản.

segments.src: That history explains why both sides are watching this round closely.
segments.tr: Lịch sử đó giải thích tại sao cả hai bên đang theo dõi sát sao vòng này.

segments.src: The administration has defended pocket rescissions as a legitimate use of its budget authority.
segments.tr: Chính quyền đã bảo vệ việc cắt giảm ngân sách kiểu bỏ túi như một việc sử dụng hợp pháp thẩm quyền ngân sách của mình.

segments.src: Critics say the earlier outcome encouraged its use again.
segments.tr: Các nhà phê bình cho rằng kết quả trước đó đã khuyến khích việc sử dụng lại nó.

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## Ai là người bị ảnh hưởng

segments.src: If the cancellation stands, the effect will be felt by the groups that receive federal money for refugee and non-citizen services.
segments.tr: Nếu việc hủy bỏ được giữ nguyên, hiệu ứng sẽ được cảm nhận bởi các nhóm nhận tiền liên bang cho các dịch vụ người tị nạn và người không phải công dân.

segments.src: That includes resettlement agencies, community organizations and the local programs that depend on them.
segments.tr: Điều đó bao gồm các cơ quan tái định cư, các tổ chức cộng đồng và các chương trình địa phương phụ thuộc vào họ.

segments.src: The cuts also reach some research and immigration-related programs.
segments.tr: Các khoản cắt giảm cũng chạm đến một số chương trình nghiên cứu và liên quan đến di trú.

segments.src: The exact effect on any one program will depend on how much of its money has already been spent or committed, and that is not clear from public reporting.
segments.tr: Tác động chính xác đối với bất kỳ chương trình nào sẽ phụ thuộc vào số tiền của nó đã được chi tiêu hoặc cam kết bao nhiêu, và điều đó không rõ ràng từ các báo cáo công khai.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Những điều cần theo dõi tiếp theo

segments.src: - **Whether the money is released or lapses.** Under the administration's approach, the funds expire on Sept. 30 unless a court or Congress intervenes.
segments.tr: - **Liệu tiền có được giải phóng hay hết hạn.** Theo cách tiếp cận của chính quyền, các quỹ sẽ hết hạn vào Sept. 30 trừ khi tòa án hoặc Quốc hội can thiệp.

segments.src: - **Legal challenges.** Affected organizations or members of Congress could go to court, as happened after the 2025 rescission.
segments.tr: - **Các thách thức pháp lý.** Các tổ chức bị ảnh hưởng hoặc các thành viên Quốc hội có thể kiện ra tòa, như đã xảy ra sau vụ thu hồi năm 2025.

segments.src: - **Congressional response.** Collins's objection is notable because it comes from the party that controls Congress and from the chair who oversees the spending bills. It could shape how future appropriations are written.
segments.tr: - **Phản ứng của Quốc hội.** Sự phản đối của Collins rất đáng chú ý vì nó đến từ đảng kiểm soát Quốc hội và từ vị chủ tịch giám sát các dự luật chi tiêu. Nó có thể định hình cách các khoản phân bổ tương lai được viết.

segments.src: - **Guardrails in future funding bills.** Lawmakers in both parties may push for language that limits or bans late-year rescission requests.
segments.tr: - **Các biện pháp bảo vệ trong các dự luật tài trợ tương lai.** Các nhà lập pháp ở cả hai đảng có thể thúc đẩy ngôn từ hạn chế hoặc cấm các yêu cầu thu hồi vào cuối năm.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: This dispute is about more than one $810 million package.
segments.tr: Tranh chấp này không chỉ xoay quanh một gói 810 triệu đô la.

segments.src: It is about who has the final say over federal spending.
segments.tr: Đó là về việc ai có quyền quyết định cuối cùng đối với chi tiêu liên bang.

segments.src: The Constitution gives Congress the power of the purse.
segments.tr: Hiến pháp trao cho Quốc hội quyền quyết định ngân sách.

segments.src: The administration argues it has the flexibility to stop spending it considers wasteful.
